examples.en: Her academic record is excellent, so she won a scholarship.
examples.zh: 她的學業成績很優秀，所以獲得了獎學金。

examples.en: The school offers many academic courses in science and history.
examples.zh: 這所學校開設許多科學與歷史的學術課程。

examples.en: Students need good academic skills to succeed at university.
examples.zh: 學生需要良好的學業能力才能在大學中成功。

examples.en: She speaks English with a slight French accent.
examples.zh: 她說英文時帶有輕微的法國口音。

examples.en: The accent in the word banana falls on the second syllable.
examples.zh: banana 這個單字的重音落在第二個音節。

examples.en: A red cushion adds a bright accent to the room.
examples.zh: 一個紅色抱枕為房間增添了亮眼的點綴。

examples.en: He received a letter of acceptance from the university.
examples.zh: 他收到了大學的錄取通知信。

examples.en: Her acceptance of the job offer made her parents happy.
examples.zh: 她接受這份工作邀約，讓她的父母很高興。

examples.en: The new rule gained wide acceptance among the students.
examples.zh: 這項新規定獲得學生們的廣泛認同。

senses.zh: 進入的方式；使用權；通道

examples.en: Students have free access to the school library.
examples.zh: 學生可以免費使用學校圖書館。

examples.en: The only access to the village is by boat.
examples.zh: 前往這個村莊唯一的方式是搭船。

examples.en: You need a password to get access to this account.
examples.zh: 你需要密碼才能登入這個帳號。

examples.en: You can access your grades on the school website.
examples.zh: 你可以在學校網站上查看你的成績。

examples.en: Many people access the news on their phones.
examples.zh: 許多人用手機看新聞。

examples.en: Please access the file from the shared folder.
examples.zh: 請從共用資料夾中開啟這個檔案。

senses.zh: 意外的；偶然的；非故意的

examples.en: The accidental fall left him with a sore ankle.
examples.zh: 那次意外跌倒讓他的腳踝很痛。

examples.en: Their accidental meeting at the airport surprised them both.
examples.zh: 他們在機場偶然相遇，兩人都很驚訝。

examples.en: The accidental deletion of the report caused a delay.
examples.zh: 報告意外遭到刪除，導致進度延誤。

examples.en: My mother will accompany me to the dentist tomorrow.
examples.zh: 我媽媽明天會陪我去看牙醫。

examples.en: A guide will accompany the group during the tour.
examples.zh: 導遊會在行程中陪同這個團體。

examples.en: She will accompany the singer on the piano.
examples.zh: 她會用鋼琴為這位歌手伴奏。

examples.en: We accomplished our goal before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我們在期限前達成了目標。

examples.en: It takes hard work to accomplish great things.
examples.zh: 要完成偉大的事需要努力。

examples.en: What do you hope to accomplish this semester?
examples.zh: 你希望這學期完成什麼事？

examples.en: My aunt works as an accountant at a large company.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在一家大公司擔任會計師。

examples.en: The accountant checked every number in the report.
examples.zh: 會計師檢查了報告中的每個數字。

examples.en: We hired an accountant to help with our taxes.
examples.zh: 我們請了一位會計師來協助報稅。

examples.en: The accuracy of this clock is very high.
examples.zh: 這個時鐘的準確度很高。

examples.en: Please check the accuracy of the information before you post it.
examples.zh: 請在發布前確認資訊的正確性。

examples.en: The player's accuracy improved after weeks of practice.
examples.zh: 這位球員的準確度在練習數週後進步了。

examples.en: Don't accuse him of lying without any proof.
examples.zh: 沒有證據就不要指責他說謊。

examples.en: The teacher accused the boy of copying the answers.
examples.zh: 老師指責那個男孩抄襲答案。

examples.en: She was accused of taking the money from the box.
examples.zh: 她被指控拿了箱子裡的錢。

examples.en: Lemon juice contains a weak acid that gives it a sour taste.
examples.zh: 檸檬汁含有一種弱酸，使它帶有酸味。

examples.en: The science teacher showed us how acid reacts with metal.
examples.zh: 自然老師向我們示範酸如何與金屬產生反應。

examples.en: Stomach acid helps our bodies break down food.
examples.zh: 胃酸幫助我們的身體分解食物。

examples.en: The soil here is too acid for most flowers.
examples.zh: 這裡的土壤對大多數花來說太酸了。

examples.en: The juice has an acid taste that I don't like.
examples.zh: 這種果汁有一股我不喜歡的酸味。

examples.en: Acid rain can damage old buildings and trees.
examples.zh: 酸雨會損害老建築與樹木。

senses.zh: 認識的人；泛泛之交；相識

examples.en: He is just an acquaintance, not a close friend.
examples.zh: 他只是認識的人，不是親近的朋友。

examples.en: I made the acquaintance of a famous writer at the party.
examples.zh: 我在派對上結識了一位知名作家。

examples.en: She has many acquaintances in the neighborhood.
examples.zh: 她在這個社區裡有很多認識的人。

examples.en: The company plans to acquire a small software firm.
examples.zh: 這家公司打算收購一間小型軟體公司。

examples.en: Children acquire language by listening to others.
examples.zh: 孩子藉由聽別人說話來習得語言。

examples.en: He acquired a taste for tea while living in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 他住在台灣時培養出了喝茶的喜好。

examples.en: We have adequate food for the whole class.
examples.zh: 我們有足夠的食物給全班。

examples.en: Is the lighting in this room adequate for reading?
examples.zh: 這個房間的光線夠閱讀嗎？

examples.en: His English is adequate for everyday conversation.
examples.zh: 他的英文足以應付日常對話。

examples.en: Please adjust the chair to fit your height.
examples.zh: 請把椅子調整到適合你的高度。

examples.en: It took her a week to adjust to the new school.
examples.zh: 她花了一週才適應新學校。

examples.en: He adjusted the volume because the music was too loud.
examples.zh: 他把音量調小了，因為音樂太大聲。

senses.zh: 令人欽佩的；值得讚賞的

examples.en: Her honesty in the difficult situation was admirable.
examples.zh: 她在困難情況下的誠實令人欽佩。

examples.en: The firefighter showed admirable courage during the rescue.
examples.zh: 這位消防員在救援中展現了令人欽佩的勇氣。

examples.en: It is admirable that he helps his neighbors every week.
examples.zh: 他每週都幫助鄰居，真是值得讚賞。

examples.en: The students have great admiration for their teacher.
examples.zh: 學生們非常敬佩他們的老師。

examples.en: She looked at the painting with admiration.
examples.zh: 她懷著讚賞的心情看著那幅畫。

examples.en: His hard work earned the admiration of his coworkers.
examples.zh: 他的努力贏得了同事們的敬佩。

senses.zh: 入場；入學許可；入場費；承認

examples.en: Admission to the museum is free for children.
examples.zh: 兒童免費進入這間博物館。

examples.en: She received a letter of admission from the university.
examples.zh: 她收到了大學的入學許可信。

examples.en: His admission that he was late surprised no one.
examples.zh: 他承認自己遲到，沒有人感到意外。

examples.en: We booked our trip through a travel agency.
examples.zh: 我們透過旅行社預訂了旅程。

examples.en: The agency helps young people find part-time jobs.
examples.zh: 這個機構協助年輕人找兼職工作。

examples.en: She works for an advertising agency in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她在台北的一家廣告公司工作。

examples.en: The singer's agent arranged a concert in Japan.
examples.zh: 這位歌手的經紀人安排了一場日本演唱會。

examples.en: A real estate agent showed us three apartments.
examples.zh: 一位房屋仲介帶我們看了三間公寓。

examples.en: You can ask the ticket agent at the counter for help.
examples.zh: 你可以向櫃檯的售票員求助。

senses.zh: 好鬥的；有攻擊性的；積極進取的

examples.en: The dog became aggressive when strangers came near.
examples.zh: 陌生人靠近時，那隻狗變得有攻擊性。

examples.en: He is an aggressive player who never gives up.
examples.zh: 他是個積極進攻、從不放棄的球員。

examples.en: The company launched an aggressive sales plan this year.
examples.zh: 這家公司今年推出了積極的銷售計畫。

senses.zh: 令人愉快的；隨和的；欣然同意的

examples.en: We spent an agreeable afternoon at the park.
examples.zh: 我們在公園度過了愉快的下午。

examples.en: My sister is an agreeable person who is easy to talk to.
examples.zh: 我姊姊是個隨和的人，很好聊天。

examples.en: If you are agreeable, we can meet at noon.
examples.zh: 如果你同意，我們可以中午碰面。

examples.en: Minors are not allowed to buy alcohol in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 在台灣，未成年人不可以購買酒類。

examples.en: Doctors say too much alcohol is bad for your health.
examples.zh: 醫生說飲酒過量對健康有害。

examples.en: The nurse cleaned the cut with alcohol.
examples.zh: 護理師用酒精清潔了傷口。

examples.en: Drivers must stay alert on long trips.
examples.zh: 駕駛在長途旅行時必須保持警覺。

examples.en: The alert guard noticed the open window right away.
examples.zh: 機警的警衛立刻注意到那扇敞開的窗戶。

examples.en: After a cup of coffee, I felt more alert.
examples.zh: 喝了一杯咖啡後，我覺得更清醒了。

examples.en: The weather bureau sent an alert about the typhoon.
examples.zh: 氣象局發出了颱風警報。

examples.en: A phone alert reminded me about the meeting.
examples.zh: 手機的提醒通知讓我想起那場會議。

examples.en: The city is on high alert because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 這座城市因為大雨而處於高度警戒。

senses.zh: 使警覺；發出警報；通知；提醒

examples.en: Please alert the teacher if you feel sick.
examples.zh: 如果你覺得不舒服，請通知老師。

examples.en: The siren alerted people to leave the building.
examples.zh: 警報器通知人們離開大樓。

examples.en: A friend alerted me to the sale at the store.
examples.zh: 朋友提醒我那間店正在特賣。

examples.en: I save part of my weekly allowance for books.
examples.zh: 我把每週零用錢的一部分存起來買書。

examples.en: Each passenger has a baggage allowance of twenty kilograms.
examples.zh: 每位乘客的行李額度是二十公斤。

examples.en: The company pays a travel allowance to its staff.
examples.zh: 公司發給員工差旅津貼。

examples.en: If the bus is late, is there an alternative?
examples.zh: 如果公車誤點，有其他替代方案嗎？

examples.en: Tea is a healthy alternative to soda.
examples.zh: 茶是汽水的健康替代品。

examples.en: We had no alternative but to wait for the rain to stop.
examples.zh: 我們別無選擇，只能等雨停。

examples.en: We took an alternative route to avoid the traffic jam.
examples.zh: 我們走了另一條路線來避開塞車。

examples.en: Solar power is an alternative source of energy.
examples.zh: 太陽能是一種替代能源。

examples.en: She is looking for an alternative way to pay the bill.
examples.zh: 她正在找另一種付帳方式。

examples.en: He is an amateur who plays tennis on weekends.
examples.zh: 他是週末打網球的業餘愛好者。

examples.en: The photo was taken by an amateur, but it looks great.
examples.zh: 這張照片是外行人拍的，但看起來很棒。

examples.en: Several amateurs joined the town's art contest.
examples.zh: 好幾位業餘者參加了鎮上的藝術比賽。

examples.en: Our school has an amateur baseball team.
examples.zh: 我們學校有一支業餘棒球隊。

examples.en: She is an amateur photographer with a lot of talent.
examples.zh: 她是個很有天分的業餘攝影師。

examples.en: The amateur chef cooked dinner for his friends.
examples.zh: 這位業餘廚師為朋友們煮了晚餐。

senses.zh: 有野心的；雄心勃勃的；艱鉅的

examples.en: She is an ambitious student who wants to study abroad.
examples.zh: 她是個有抱負的學生，想出國念書。

examples.en: The team made an ambitious plan to build a new school.
examples.zh: 這個團隊擬定了興建新學校的宏大計畫。

examples.en: My brother is too ambitious to stay in a low-paying job.
examples.zh: 我哥哥企圖心太強，不會一直做低薪工作。

examples.en: The clown amused the children with funny tricks.
examples.zh: 小丑用有趣的把戲逗樂了孩子們。

examples.en: His jokes always amuse his classmates during the lunch break.
examples.zh: 午休時，他的笑話總是讓同學們開心。

examples.en: She amused herself by reading comic books on the train.
examples.zh: 她在火車上看漫畫來打發時間。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to write an analysis of the poem.
examples.zh: 老師要我們寫一篇詩的分析。

examples.en: A careful analysis of the data took three days.
examples.zh: 仔細分析這些資料花了三天。

examples.en: The doctor ordered an analysis of my blood.
examples.zh: 醫生安排了驗血分析。

examples.en: Scientists analyze water samples in the laboratory to check for pollution.
examples.zh: 科學家在實驗室裡分析水樣，以檢查是否有污染。

examples.en: Let's analyze the sales numbers before the meeting.
examples.zh: 我們在會議前先分析一下銷售數字。

examples.en: The students analyzed the story and shared their ideas.
examples.zh: 學生們分析了這個故事並分享他們的想法。

examples.en: My ancestors came to Taiwan about two hundred years ago.
examples.zh: 我的祖先大約兩百年前來到台灣。

examples.en: Many families honor their ancestors during Tomb Sweeping Day.
examples.zh: 許多家庭在清明節時祭拜祖先。

examples.en: Scientists study the ancestors of modern birds.
examples.zh: 科學家研究現代鳥類的祖先。

examples.en: My parents celebrated their wedding anniversary at a restaurant.
examples.zh: 我的父母在餐廳慶祝結婚紀念日。

examples.en: The school held a party for its fiftieth anniversary.
examples.zh: 學校為五十週年校慶舉辦了派對。

examples.en: Don't forget our anniversary next Friday; we have dinner reservations.
examples.zh: 別忘了我們下週五的紀念日；我們已經訂好晚餐了。

examples.en: Loud music at night can annoy the neighbors.
examples.zh: 夜裡的大聲音樂會惹惱鄰居。

examples.en: Stop tapping your pen, because it really annoys me.
examples.zh: 別再敲筆了，這真的很煩人。

examples.en: My little brother likes to annoy me when I study.
examples.zh: 我讀書時，弟弟很愛來煩我。

examples.en: The school holds an annual sports day in October.
examples.zh: 學校在十月舉辦年度運動會。

examples.en: Our annual trip to the beach is always fun.
examples.zh: 我們每年一次的海邊旅行總是很好玩。

examples.en: She read the company's annual report carefully.
examples.zh: 她仔細閱讀了公司的年度報告。

examples.en: She felt anxiety before her first job interview.
examples.zh: 她在第一次面試前感到焦慮。

examples.en: Exams often cause anxiety among students who worry about their grades.
examples.zh: 考試常讓擔心成績的學生感到焦慮。

examples.en: Deep breathing can help reduce anxiety before an important interview.
examples.zh: 重要面試前，深呼吸有助於減輕焦慮。

examples.en: He sent an apology to his teacher for being late.
examples.zh: 他因遲到向老師道歉。

examples.en: I owe you an apology for forgetting your birthday.
examples.zh: 我忘了你的生日，欠你一個道歉。

examples.en: The store made a public apology for the mistake.
examples.zh: 這家店為了這個錯誤公開道歉。

examples.en: It was apparent that she had not slept well.
examples.zh: 很明顯她沒有睡好。

examples.en: The reason for his sadness soon became apparent.
examples.zh: 他難過的原因很快就明朗了。

examples.en: There is no apparent cause for the power failure.
examples.zh: 停電沒有明顯的原因。

examples.en: Ten applicants came to the interview on Monday.
examples.zh: 週一有十位應徵者來參加面試。

examples.en: Each applicant must fill out a form.
examples.zh: 每位申請人都必須填寫一份表格。

examples.en: Thousands of applicants applied to the university this year.
examples.zh: 今年有數千名申請人向這所大學提出申請。

senses.zh: 申請；申請書；應用程式；應用

examples.en: Please send your job application by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在週五前寄出你的工作申請。

examples.en: I downloaded a new application to learn English.
examples.zh: 我下載了一個新的應用程式來學英文。

examples.en: The application of this rule is not always easy.
examples.zh: 這項規定的應用並不總是容易。

examples.en: The principal will appoint a new class leader.
examples.zh: 校長將指派一位新的班長。

examples.en: They appointed her as the manager of the store.
examples.zh: 他們任命她為這間店的經理。

examples.en: Let's appoint a time and place for the meeting.
examples.zh: 我們來約定開會的時間與地點。

examples.en: She sent flowers to show her appreciation.
examples.zh: 她送花表達感激之意。

examples.en: The class gave the teacher a card as a sign of appreciation.
examples.zh: 全班送老師一張卡片表示謝意。

examples.en: His appreciation of music grew as he got older.
examples.zh: 隨著年紀增長，他對音樂的欣賞力也越來越高。

examples.en: Jeans are not appropriate for a formal dinner.
examples.zh: 牛仔褲不適合穿去正式晚宴。

examples.en: Please choose an appropriate title for your essay.
examples.zh: 請為你的文章選一個合適的標題。

examples.en: It is not appropriate to talk loudly in the library.
examples.zh: 在圖書館大聲說話是不恰當的。

examples.en: You need your parents' approval to join the trip.
examples.zh: 你需要父母同意才能參加這次旅行。

examples.en: The plan is waiting for approval from the manager.
examples.zh: 這項計畫正等待經理的批准。

examples.en: She smiled with approval when she saw my grades.
examples.zh: 她看到我的成績時，滿意地笑了。

examples.en: We watched sharks and sea turtles at the aquarium.
examples.zh: 我們在水族館看了鯊魚和海龜。

examples.en: He cleans his aquarium and changes the water every month.
examples.zh: 他每個月清理養魚缸並換水。

examples.en: The new aquarium in the city is popular with families.
examples.zh: 城裡新開的水族館很受家庭歡迎。

examples.en: We walked under the stone arch to enter the old town.
examples.zh: 我們穿過石造拱門進入老城區。

examples.en: The stone bridge has three large arches above the river.
examples.zh: 這座石橋在河面上有三座大型橋拱。

examples.en: Rain dripped from the arch above the door.
examples.zh: 雨水從門上方的拱形處滴落。

examples.en: The cat arched its back and hissed.
examples.zh: 那隻貓拱起背並發出嘶聲。

examples.en: The tall trees arch over the path.
examples.zh: 高大的樹木在小徑上方形成拱形。

examples.en: She arched her eyebrows in surprise when she heard the news.
examples.zh: 她聽到這個消息時，驚訝地揚起了眉毛。

examples.en: Problems may arise if we do not plan ahead.
examples.zh: 如果我們不事先規劃，可能會出現問題。

examples.en: A new question arose during the discussion.
examples.zh: 討論過程中出現了一個新問題。

examples.en: If a problem arises, please call me.
examples.zh: 如果發生問題，請打電話給我。

senses.zh: 人造的；人工的；不自然的

examples.en: This shop sells artificial flowers that look real.
examples.zh: 這家店賣看起來很逼真的人造花。

examples.en: Artificial sweeteners are used in many drinks.
examples.zh: 許多飲料中使用了人工甘味劑。

examples.en: Her smile looked artificial, as if she was not happy.
examples.zh: 她的笑容看起來很不自然，好像並不開心。

examples.en: My sister is very artistic and loves to paint.
examples.zh: 我姊姊很有藝術天分，也愛畫畫。

examples.en: The room has an artistic design with colorful walls.
examples.zh: 這個房間設計得很有藝術感，牆面色彩繽紛。

examples.en: He wants to develop his artistic skills at art school.
examples.zh: 他想在藝術學校培養自己的藝術能力。

examples.en: He felt ashamed of lying to his parents.
examples.zh: 他對欺騙父母感到羞愧。

examples.en: You should not be ashamed to ask for help.
examples.zh: 你不必羞於開口求助。

examples.en: She was ashamed of her poor test results.
examples.zh: 她對自己糟糕的考試成績感到難為情。

examples.en: We should consider every aspect of the plan before we decide.
examples.zh: 我們決定之前，應該先考慮這個計畫的各個方面。

examples.en: Which aspect of the job do you enjoy the most?
examples.zh: 這份工作的哪個層面你最喜歡？

examples.en: The teacher explained one aspect of the problem at a time.
examples.zh: 老師一次說明問題的一個面向。

examples.en: She took an aspirin because she had a headache.
examples.zh: 她頭痛，所以吃了一顆阿斯匹靈。

examples.en: Aspirin can help lower a fever in some adults.
examples.zh: 阿斯匹靈可以幫助部分成人退燒。

examples.en: The pharmacist told him not to take aspirin on an empty stomach.
examples.zh: 藥師告訴他不要空腹吃阿斯匹靈。

examples.en: It took us an hour to assemble the new bookshelf.
examples.zh: 我們花了一個小時組裝新的書架。

examples.en: Students must assemble on the playground at eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 學生必須在八點到操場集合。

examples.en: The manager assembled a team to finish the project.
examples.zh: 經理召集了一個團隊來完成這項專案。

examples.en: The principal spoke to the whole school at the morning assembly.
examples.zh: 校長在晨間集會時對全校師生講話。

examples.en: The assembly of this desk takes about twenty minutes.
examples.zh: 組裝這張書桌大約要二十分鐘。

examples.en: The national assembly passed the new law last week.
examples.zh: 國民議會上週通過了這項新法律。

examples.en: The teacher assigned a short essay for homework.
examples.zh: 老師指定了一篇短文當作業。

examples.en: The company assigned her to the sales department.
examples.zh: 公司把她派到業務部門。

examples.en: Each student was assigned a seat in the classroom.
examples.zh: 每位學生都被分配了教室裡的一個座位。

examples.en: Thank you for your assistance with the move.
examples.zh: 謝謝你協助我們搬家。

examples.en: Passengers who need assistance should ask the staff.
examples.zh: 需要協助的乘客請詢問工作人員。

examples.en: The school offers financial assistance to students in need.
examples.zh: 學校提供經濟援助給有需要的學生。

examples.en: Many people associate the color red with good luck.
examples.zh: 許多人會把紅色和好運聯想在一起。

examples.en: He does not want to be associated with the scandal.
examples.zh: 他不想和那件醜聞扯上關係。

examples.en: She likes to associate with people who love reading.
examples.zh: 她喜歡和愛閱讀的人往來。

examples.en: My business associate will meet us at the airport.
examples.zh: 我的生意夥伴會在機場和我們碰面。

examples.en: She is an associate of the law firm.
examples.zh: 她是這間律師事務所的受僱律師。

examples.en: He introduced me to an associate from his office.
examples.zh: 他向我介紹了他辦公室的一位同事。

examples.en: He joined the local teachers' association last year.
examples.zh: 他去年加入了當地的教師協會。

examples.en: The smell of bread has a strong association with my childhood.
examples.zh: 麵包的香味讓我強烈聯想到童年。

examples.en: There is a close association between sleep and health.
examples.zh: 睡眠與健康之間有密切的關聯。

examples.en: The manager gave us his assurance that the goods would arrive on time.
examples.zh: 經理向我們保證貨物會準時送達。

examples.en: She spoke with the assurance of an experienced teacher.
examples.zh: 她說話時帶著經驗豐富的老師那種自信。

examples.en: We need some assurance that the price will not go up.
examples.zh: 我們需要有人保證價格不會上漲。

examples.en: I assure you that the food is safe to eat.
examples.zh: 我向你保證這些食物可以安心食用。

examples.en: The doctor assured her that the operation was simple.
examples.zh: 醫生要她放心，這個手術很簡單。

examples.en: This lock will assure the safety of your bike.
examples.zh: 這個鎖可以確保你腳踏車的安全。

senses.zh: 運動的；體格健壯的；體育的

examples.en: He has an athletic build because he runs every morning.
examples.zh: 他每天早上跑步，所以體格健壯。

examples.en: The school holds an athletic meet every autumn.
examples.zh: 學校每年秋天都舉辦運動會。

examples.en: She bought a pair of athletic shoes for gym class.
examples.zh: 她買了一雙體育課穿的運動鞋。

examples.en: The atmosphere of Earth protects us from harmful rays.
examples.zh: 地球的大氣層保護我們不受有害射線的傷害。

examples.en: The cafe has a warm and friendly atmosphere.
examples.zh: 這間咖啡店的氣氛溫暖又親切。

examples.en: A quiet atmosphere helps students focus on their work.
examples.zh: 安靜的環境能幫助學生專心做功課。

examples.en: The air, water, and rocks around us are made of atoms.
examples.zh: 我們周遭的空氣、水和岩石都是由原子組成的。

examples.en: An atom is too small to be seen with the eye.
examples.zh: 原子小到肉眼看不見。

examples.en: The science teacher drew a model of an atom on the board.
examples.zh: 自然科老師在黑板上畫了一個原子的模型。

examples.en: The atomic number of hydrogen is one.
examples.zh: 氫的原子序是一。

examples.en: The class learned about atomic structure in science class.
examples.zh: 全班在自然課學了原子結構。

examples.en: Atomic energy can be used to make electricity.
examples.zh: 原子能可以用來發電。

examples.en: Please attach your photo to the application form.
examples.zh: 請把你的照片附在申請表上。

examples.en: I attached the file to my email.
examples.zh: 我把檔案附在電子郵件裡。

examples.en: She attached a name tag to her suitcase.
examples.zh: 她在行李箱上繫了一個名牌。

senses.zh: 吸引力；景點；吸引人的事物

examples.en: The Taipei 101 tower is a popular tourist attraction.
examples.zh: 台北 101 是熱門的觀光景點。

examples.en: The beautiful beach is the main attraction of the town.
examples.zh: 美麗的海灘是這座小鎮最大的吸引力。

examples.en: Many young people feel a strong attraction to new technology.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人對新科技有強烈的興趣。

examples.en: This video has an audio problem, so I cannot hear the speaker.
examples.zh: 這部影片的音訊有問題，我聽不到講者的聲音。

examples.en: Please check the audio equipment before the meeting starts.
examples.zh: 會議開始前請先檢查音響設備。

examples.en: You can download the audio file from our website.
examples.zh: 你可以從我們的網站下載音訊檔。

examples.en: The audio of the movie is clear and loud.
examples.zh: 這部電影的聲音又清楚又大聲。

examples.en: I turned off the audio and read the subtitles.
examples.zh: 我關掉聲音，看字幕。

examples.en: The audio is out of sync with the video.
examples.zh: 聲音和畫面不同步。

examples.en: Only the manager has the authority to approve the plan.
examples.zh: 只有經理有權核准這個計畫。

examples.en: Local authorities closed the road because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 地方當局因為大雨封閉了這條道路。

examples.en: She is an authority on ancient history.
examples.zh: 她是古代史的權威。

examples.en: He wrote an autobiography about his life as a farmer.
examples.zh: 他寫了一本關於他務農生活的自傳。

examples.en: The library has her autobiography on the second floor.
examples.zh: 圖書館二樓有她的自傳。

examples.en: We had to read an autobiography for English class.
examples.zh: 我們英文課必須讀一本自傳。

examples.en: Passengers should await further news in the waiting room.
examples.zh: 乘客請在候車室等候進一步的消息。

examples.en: We are awaiting the test results from the hospital.
examples.zh: 我們正在等候醫院的檢驗結果。

examples.en: A big surprise awaits you at home.
examples.zh: 家裡有一個大驚喜在等著你。

senses.zh: 禿頭的；光禿的；胎紋磨平的

examples.en: My uncle went bald when he was thirty.
examples.zh: 我叔叔三十歲就禿頭了。

examples.en: The baby is still almost bald, with only a few soft hairs.
examples.zh: 這個寶寶還幾乎沒有頭髮，只有幾根柔軟的毛髮。

examples.en: The bald tire was not safe to drive on.
examples.zh: 那條胎紋磨平的輪胎在行駛時並不安全。

examples.en: She has taken ballet lessons since she was five.
examples.zh: 她從五歲起就學芭蕾舞。

examples.en: We watched a ballet at the national theater last night.
examples.zh: 我們昨晚在國家劇院看了一齣芭蕾舞劇。

examples.en: Ballet shoes are soft and light, allowing dancers to move easily.
examples.zh: 芭蕾舞鞋又軟又輕，讓舞者能輕鬆移動。

examples.en: The nurse put a clean bandage on his arm.
examples.zh: 護理師在他的手臂上包了乾淨的繃帶。

examples.en: Keep a bandage in your bag in case of small cuts.
examples.zh: 包包裡放一捲繃帶，以防小傷口。

examples.en: She changed the bandage twice a day.
examples.zh: 她一天換兩次繃帶。

examples.en: The doctor bandaged my sprained ankle after checking it carefully.
examples.zh: 醫生仔細檢查我扭傷的腳踝後，用繃帶加以包紮。

examples.en: Please bandage the cut before you play.
examples.zh: 玩之前請先把傷口包紮好。

examples.en: He bandaged his knee after falling off his bike.
examples.zh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來後，把膝蓋包紮起來。

examples.en: The small shop went bankrupt after the new mall opened.
examples.zh: 那家小店在新的購物中心開幕後倒閉了。

examples.en: The bankrupt company could not pay its workers.
examples.zh: 破產的公司付不出員工的薪水。

examples.en: He was declared bankrupt last spring after his business failed.
examples.zh: 他的生意失敗後，於去年春天被宣告破產。

examples.en: Poor decisions nearly bankrupted the family business.
examples.zh: 錯誤的決定差點使這家家族企業破產。

examples.en: The high rent bankrupted many small restaurants.
examples.zh: 高昂的租金使許多小餐廳破產。

examples.en: Too much debt can bankrupt a person.
examples.zh: 負債過多會使人破產。

senses.zh: 特價品；划算的交易；協議

examples.en: This jacket was a real bargain at half price.
examples.zh: 這件夾克半價真的很划算。

examples.en: Shoppers lined up early to look for bargains.
examples.zh: 購物的人很早就排隊要找特價品。

examples.en: They made a bargain to share the cost of the trip.
examples.zh: 他們協議分攤這趟旅行的費用。

examples.en: Tourists often bargain with sellers at the night market.
examples.zh: 遊客常在夜市跟攤販討價還價。

examples.en: She bargained with the driver over the price.
examples.zh: 她和司機議價。

examples.en: It is not polite to bargain in a department store.
examples.zh: 在百貨公司討價還價不太禮貌。

examples.en: Language can be a barrier when you travel abroad.
examples.zh: 出國旅行時，語言可能是一種障礙。

examples.en: A low barrier stopped cars from entering the park.
examples.zh: 一道矮柵欄擋住了要進入公園的車輛。

examples.en: Shyness is a big barrier to making friends.
examples.zh: 害羞是交朋友的一大障礙。

examples.en: She filled the basin with warm water.
examples.zh: 她在臉盆裡裝滿溫水。

examples.en: The city sits in a basin surrounded by mountains.
examples.zh: 這座城市位在群山環繞的盆地中。

examples.en: Please wash your hands in the basin.
examples.zh: 請在洗手台洗手。

examples.en: The battery in my phone runs out quickly.
examples.zh: 我手機的電池很快就沒電。

examples.en: We need new batteries for the remote control.
examples.zh: 我們需要幫遙控器換新電池。

examples.en: This laptop battery lasts about ten hours.
examples.zh: 這台筆記型電腦的電池可以用大約十個小時。

examples.en: A beggar sat near the station asking for coins.
examples.zh: 一名乞丐坐在車站附近討零錢。

examples.en: The old beggar thanked us for the sandwich.
examples.zh: 那位年老的乞丐謝謝我們給他三明治。

examples.en: In the story, a kind man shares his food with a beggar.
examples.zh: 故事中，一位好心人和乞丐分享他的食物。

examples.en: The teacher praised the children for their good behavior.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚孩子們行為良好。

examples.en: Rude behavior is not allowed in our classroom.
examples.zh: 我們教室裡不允許粗魯的行為。

examples.en: The scientist studies the behavior of birds.
examples.zh: 這位科學家研究鳥類的行為。

examples.en: Please throw the paper into the recycling bin.
examples.zh: 請把紙丟進資源回收桶。

examples.en: The bin by the door is full of old newspapers.
examples.zh: 門邊的箱子裡裝滿了舊報紙。

examples.en: He keeps his toys in a plastic bin under the bed.
examples.zh: 他把玩具放在床下的塑膠箱裡。

examples.en: I borrowed a biography of Albert Einstein from the library.
examples.zh: 我從圖書館借了一本愛因斯坦的傳記。

examples.en: The biography tells the story of her childhood in Tainan.
examples.zh: 這本傳記描述了她在台南的童年。

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to write a short biography of a famous person.
examples.zh: 老師要我們寫一篇名人的簡短傳記。

examples.en: Blend the milk and the eggs in a large bowl.
examples.zh: 把牛奶和蛋在大碗裡混合。

examples.en: The colors blend well with each other.
examples.zh: 這些顏色彼此很搭。

examples.en: The old building blends in with the quiet street.
examples.zh: 這棟老建築與安靜的街道很協調。

examples.en: This tea is a blend of green tea and flowers.
examples.zh: 這種茶是綠茶和花的混合。

examples.en: The song is a blend of rock and traditional music.
examples.zh: 這首歌融合了搖滾與傳統音樂。

examples.en: The soup has a nice blend of spices.
examples.zh: 這道湯的香料調配得很好。

examples.en: The old man gave the young couple his blessing.
examples.zh: 老先生給了這對年輕夫妻他的祝福。

examples.en: Good health is a great blessing that we should never take for granted.
examples.zh: 健康是一大福氣，我們絕不應視為理所當然。

examples.en: The rain was a blessing for the farmers.
examples.zh: 這場雨對農夫來說是件好事。

examples.en: She blinked when the bright light hit her eyes.
examples.zh: 強光照到她的眼睛時，她眨了眨眼。

examples.en: Try not to blink while I take the photo.
examples.zh: 我拍照時，盡量不要眨眼。

examples.en: The red light blinked on the dashboard.
examples.zh: 儀表板上的紅燈在閃爍。

examples.en: The blink of an eye is very short.
examples.zh: 眨眼的時間非常短。

examples.en: Summer vacation was over in a blink.
examples.zh: 暑假一眨眼就結束了。

examples.en: The goalkeeper stopped the ball in the blink of an eye.
examples.zh: 守門員一眨眼就擋住了球。

examples.en: Cherry trees bloom in early spring, attracting visitors to the park.
examples.zh: 櫻花樹在初春開花，吸引遊客前來公園。

examples.en: The roses in our garden bloom every June.
examples.zh: 我們花園裡的玫瑰在六月盛開。

examples.en: Her confidence began to bloom after she joined the choir.
examples.zh: 她加入合唱團後，自信開始綻放。

examples.en: The tulips are in full bloom this week.
examples.zh: 鬱金香這個禮拜正盛開。

examples.en: She put a single bloom in a glass vase.
examples.zh: 她把一朵花插進玻璃花瓶。

examples.en: The garden is beautiful when the blooms open.
examples.zh: 花朵盛開的時候，花園很美。

examples.en: Apple blossoms smell sweet in the spring.
examples.zh: 蘋果花在春天聞起來很香甜。

examples.en: Tourists come to see the cherry blossoms every year.
examples.zh: 每年都有遊客前來賞櫻花。

examples.en: The peach tree is in full blossom.
examples.zh: 桃樹正值盛開期。

examples.en: Plum trees blossom in the cold of winter.
examples.zh: 梅樹在寒冬中開花。

examples.en: The shy boy blossomed into a confident speaker.
examples.zh: 那個害羞的男孩成長為一位有自信的演講者。

examples.en: Their friendship blossomed over the summer as they worked together.
examples.zh: 他們在夏天一起工作，友誼也逐漸深厚。

examples.en: He likes to boast about his high test scores.
examples.zh: 他喜歡吹噓自己的高分成績。

examples.en: Don't boast about your new phone in front of everyone.
examples.zh: 不要在大家面前炫耀你的新手機。

examples.en: The city boasts a beautiful lake and a famous temple.
examples.zh: 這座城市擁有美麗的湖泊和一座著名的廟宇。

senses.zh: 自誇的話；引以為傲的事

examples.en: His boast about winning every game was not true.
examples.zh: 他吹噓自己每場比賽都贏，但那並非事實。

examples.en: It is her proud boast that she never missed a class.
examples.zh: 她引以為傲的是從來沒缺過課。

examples.en: Nobody believed the boast of the new player.
examples.zh: 沒有人相信那位新球員的大話。

examples.en: There is a strong bond between the two sisters.
examples.zh: 這兩姊妹之間有深厚的情誼。

examples.en: Shared meals create a bond between family members.
examples.zh: 一起吃飯能增進家人之間的感情。

examples.en: She bought a government bond as a safe investment.
examples.zh: 她買了政府公債作為安全的投資。

examples.en: The team bonded during the camping trip.
examples.zh: 這個團隊在露營旅行中建立了感情。

examples.en: Babies bond with their parents in the first months.
examples.zh: 寶寶在最初幾個月會與父母建立依附關係。

examples.en: This glue bonds wood to metal without leaving visible marks.
examples.zh: 這種膠水能把木頭黏在金屬上，而不留下明顯痕跡。

examples.en: The ball bounced down the stairs and landed near the door.
examples.zh: 球沿著樓梯彈下去，落在門邊。

examples.en: Children love to bounce on the soft bed.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡在柔軟的床上彈跳。

examples.en: The email bounced back because the address was wrong.
examples.zh: 這封電子郵件因為地址錯誤而被退回。

examples.en: The ball has a high bounce on the hard gym floor.
examples.zh: 這顆球在堅硬的體育館地板上會彈得很高。

examples.en: With one bounce, the ball rolled into the net.
examples.zh: 球彈了一下就滾進了網子。

examples.en: The new shoes give each step a nice bounce.
examples.zh: 這雙新鞋讓每一步都很有彈性。

examples.en: She wears a silver bracelet on her left wrist.
examples.zh: 她的左手腕戴著一條銀手鍊。

examples.en: My grandmother gave me a jade bracelet for my birthday.
examples.zh: 奶奶送我一只玉鐲當生日禮物。

examples.en: The bracelet fell off while she was running.
examples.zh: 她跑步時手鍊掉了。

examples.en: A poodle is a popular breed of dog.
examples.zh: 貴賓狗是一種受歡迎的狗品種。

examples.en: This breed of cow gives a lot of milk.
examples.zh: 這個品種的乳牛產很多奶。

examples.en: What breed is your cat with the long white fur?
examples.zh: 你那隻長著白色長毛的貓是什麼品種？

examples.en: Farmers breed horses on the large ranch.
examples.zh: 農夫們在大牧場上繁殖馬匹。

examples.en: Many birds breed in the north during summer.
examples.zh: 許多鳥在夏天於北方繁殖。

examples.en: The scientist tried to breed a sweeter kind of corn.
examples.zh: 這位科學家試著培育更甜的玉米品種。

examples.en: The bridegroom waited at the front of the church.
examples.zh: 新郎在教堂前方等候。

examples.en: The bride and the bridegroom cut the cake together.
examples.zh: 新娘和新郎一起切蛋糕。

examples.en: Everyone clapped when the bridegroom arrived at the wedding reception.
examples.zh: 新郎抵達婚宴現場時，大家都鼓掌。

examples.en: I can't go shopping because I'm broke this month.
examples.zh: 我這個月沒錢，沒辦法去逛街。

examples.en: He was broke after paying the rent.
examples.zh: 他付完房租後就沒錢了。

examples.en: The students were too broke to eat at a nice restaurant.
examples.zh: 學生們窮到沒錢去好一點的餐廳吃飯。

examples.en: She swept the kitchen floor with a broom.
examples.zh: 她用掃把掃廚房的地板。

examples.en: The broom is behind the door, next to the dustpan.
examples.zh: 掃把在門後面，就在畚箕旁邊。

examples.en: The children made a toy horse from an old broom.
examples.zh: 孩子們用舊掃把做了一匹玩具馬。

senses.zh: 殘酷的；嚴酷的；毫不留情的

examples.en: The brutal heat made it hard to play outside.
examples.zh: 酷熱的天氣讓人很難到戶外玩耍。

examples.en: It was a brutal winter with a lot of snow.
examples.zh: 那是一個下了很多雪的嚴冬。

examples.en: His brutal honesty about her performance hurt her feelings.
examples.zh: 他對她表現毫不留情的坦白傷了她的心。

examples.en: The school posted a bulletin about the field trip.
examples.zh: 學校貼出了校外教學的公告。

examples.en: Please read the bulletin board near the office.
examples.zh: 請看辦公室附近的佈告欄。

examples.en: The radio station gave a weather bulletin every hour.
examples.zh: 廣播電台每小時播報一次天氣簡報。

examples.en: The burglar broke a window and entered the house.
examples.zh: 竊賊打破窗戶進入了房子。

examples.en: A burglar alarm rang in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 防盜警報在半夜響了起來。

examples.en: The police caught the burglar a week later.
examples.zh: 一週後警方抓到了那個竊賊。

examples.en: Please calculate the total price of these three items.
examples.zh: 請計算這三樣東西的總價。

examples.en: We calculated the cost of the trip before booking.
examples.zh: 我們在訂位前先估算了旅費。

examples.en: Students can use a calculator to calculate the answer.
examples.zh: 學生可以用計算機算出答案。

examples.en: The school started a campaign to save water.
examples.zh: 學校發起了一項節約用水的活動。

examples.en: The company launched an advertising campaign for its new snack.
examples.zh: 公司為新推出的點心展開了廣告宣傳活動。

examples.en: She ran a campaign to become class president.
examples.zh: 她為了當班長而展開競選。

examples.en: Students campaigned for cleaner parks in the city.
examples.zh: 學生們為了讓城市的公園更乾淨而發起運動。

examples.en: She campaigned hard for a seat on the school council.
examples.zh: 她為了取得學生會席次而努力競選。

examples.en: Many people campaign against the use of plastic bags.
examples.zh: 許多人發起運動反對使用塑膠袋。

examples.en: Each candidate gave a short speech before the class vote.
examples.zh: 每位候選人在班級投票前都發表了一段簡短的演說。

examples.en: The company interviewed five candidates for the sales position.
examples.zh: 公司為業務職位面試了五位應徵者。

examples.en: She is a strong candidate for the scholarship this year.
examples.zh: 她是今年獎學金的有力人選。

examples.en: My grandfather walks with a cane after his knee surgery.
examples.zh: 我爺爺膝蓋手術後拄著手杖走路。

examples.en: The old chair was made of cane and wood.
examples.zh: 這張舊椅子是用藤條和木頭做成的。

examples.en: Farmers cut the cane by hand before sending it to the factory.
examples.zh: 農夫以人工方式砍下甘蔗莖，再送到工廠。

examples.en: We rented a canoe and paddled across the quiet lake.
examples.zh: 我們租了一艘獨木舟，划過平靜的湖面。

examples.en: The canoe was too small for four adults.
examples.zh: 這艘獨木舟對四個大人來說太小了。

examples.en: He learned to steer a canoe at summer camp.
examples.zh: 他在夏令營學會了如何操控獨木舟。

examples.en: They plan to canoe down the river this weekend.
examples.zh: 他們計畫這個週末划獨木舟順流而下。

examples.en: We canoed for three hours before stopping for lunch.
examples.zh: 我們划了三個小時的獨木舟才停下來吃午餐。

examples.en: Do you want to canoe with us on Saturday?
examples.zh: 你星期六想和我們一起去划獨木舟嗎？

examples.en: The stadium has a capacity of fifty thousand people.
examples.zh: 這座體育場的容納量是五萬人。

examples.en: Her capacity for hard work impressed everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 她努力工作的能力讓辦公室裡的每個人都印象深刻。

examples.en: The factory is running at full capacity this month.
examples.zh: 這間工廠這個月正以滿載產能運轉。

examples.en: The capitalist invested a large sum in the new company.
examples.zh: 這位資本家把一大筆錢投資在新公司上。

examples.en: Some capitalists believe the market should have few rules.
examples.zh: 有些資本主義者認為市場應該只有少數規範。

examples.en: The book tells the story of a young capitalist in the 1900s.
examples.zh: 這本書講述一位二十世紀初年輕資本家的故事。

examples.en: Taiwan has a capitalist economy based on free trade.
examples.zh: 台灣的經濟是以自由貿易為基礎的資本主義經濟。

examples.en: The teacher compared capitalist and socialist systems in class.
examples.zh: 老師在課堂上比較了資本主義與社會主義制度。

examples.en: Many capitalist countries use taxes to support public schools.
examples.zh: 許多資本主義國家用稅收來支持公立學校。

examples.en: The ship carried a cargo of rice from Thailand.
examples.zh: 這艘船載運了一批來自泰國的稻米。

examples.en: Workers unloaded the cargo at the harbor this morning.
examples.zh: 工人今天早上在港口卸下貨物。

examples.en: The plane has extra space for cargo in the back.
examples.zh: 這架飛機的後方有額外的貨物空間。

examples.en: He likes to carve small animals out of wood.
examples.zh: 他喜歡用木頭雕刻小動物。

examples.en: Dad will carve the turkey at the dinner table.
examples.zh: 爸爸會在餐桌上切開火雞肉。

examples.en: She worked hard to carve out a career in the fashion industry.
examples.zh: 她努力在時尚產業中開創一番事業。

examples.en: The noise will cease when the machine is turned off.
examples.zh: 機器關掉後，噪音就會停止。

examples.en: The company ceased production after the factory closed.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉後，公司就停止了生產。

examples.en: Please cease talking and open your textbooks to page ten.
examples.zh: 請停止說話，把課本翻到第十頁。

examples.en: The whole town joined the celebration of the new year.
examples.zh: 全鎮的人都參加了新年的慶祝活動。

examples.en: We had a small celebration for my sister's birthday.
examples.zh: 我們為姊姊的生日辦了一場小小的慶祝會。

examples.en: There will be a celebration after the final exam.
examples.zh: 期末考之後會有一場慶祝活動。

examples.en: The king waited for the guests in his private chamber.
examples.zh: 國王在他的私人寢室裡等候客人。

examples.en: The new law passed in the upper chamber yesterday.
examples.zh: 新法律昨天在上議院通過了。

examples.en: The heart has four chambers that pump blood through the body.
examples.zh: 心臟有四個腔室，負責把血液送往全身。

examples.en: Our school team won the basketball championship last year.
examples.zh: 我們學校的隊伍去年贏得了籃球錦標賽。

examples.en: The championship will be held in Taipei next month.
examples.zh: 這場錦標賽下個月將在台北舉行。

examples.en: She trained for years to win the national championship.
examples.zh: 她訓練多年，只為贏得全國冠軍頭銜。

examples.en: Kindness is the most important characteristic of a good teacher.
examples.zh: 親切是好老師最重要的特質。

examples.en: Each animal has its own special characteristics.
examples.zh: 每種動物都有自己獨特的特徵。

examples.en: A long neck is a characteristic of giraffes.
examples.zh: 長脖子是長頸鹿的特徵。

examples.en: The cake had the characteristic taste of fresh lemons.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕有新鮮檸檬特有的味道。

examples.en: Her characteristic smile made everyone feel welcome.
examples.zh: 她那獨特的笑容讓每個人都覺得受到歡迎。

examples.en: Loud laughter is characteristic of my uncle.
examples.zh: 大聲的笑是我叔叔的典型特色。

examples.en: She gives part of her salary to a local charity.
examples.zh: 她把部分薪水捐給當地的慈善機構。

examples.en: The school held a concert to raise money for charity.
examples.zh: 學校舉辦音樂會為慈善活動募款。

examples.en: He does not want charity; he wants a job with fair pay.
examples.zh: 他不想要施捨，而是想要一份待遇公平的工作。

examples.en: I will always cherish the time I spent with my grandmother.
examples.zh: 我會永遠珍惜與奶奶相處的時光。

examples.en: She cherishes the old photo her father gave her.
examples.zh: 她很珍視爸爸送給她的那張老照片。

examples.en: Many students cherish the hope of studying abroad.
examples.zh: 許多學生懷抱著出國讀書的希望。

examples.en: Please chew your food slowly before you swallow it.
examples.zh: 吞下去之前，請把食物慢慢嚼碎。

examples.en: The puppy likes to chew on my old slippers.
examples.zh: 這隻小狗喜歡咬我的舊拖鞋。

examples.en: He chewed gum all through the long bus ride.
examples.zh: 他在漫長的公車路程中一直嚼口香糖。

examples.en: The dog is busy with a chew from the pet store.
examples.zh: 這隻狗正忙著啃從寵物店買來的咬嚼玩具。

examples.en: Give the meat a good chew before you swallow.
examples.zh: 吞下去之前，先把肉好好嚼一嚼。

examples.en: This candy is a soft chew with a fruit flavor.
examples.zh: 這種糖是水果口味的軟嚼糖。

examples.en: Don't talk while eating, or you may choke.
examples.zh: 吃東西時不要說話，否則可能會噎到。

examples.en: Smoke from the kitchen began to choke the people in the room.
examples.zh: 廚房冒出的煙開始讓房裡的人喘不過氣。

examples.en: Leaves can choke the drain after a heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，落葉可能會堵住排水孔。

examples.en: She sings in the school chorus every Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 她每個星期五下午都在學校合唱團唱歌。

examples.en: Everyone joined in on the chorus of the song.
examples.zh: 大家都跟著唱起這首歌的副歌。

examples.en: The students answered in chorus, "Good morning, teacher!"
examples.zh: 學生們齊聲回答：「老師早！」

examples.en: We sat around a circular table in the meeting room.
examples.zh: 我們圍坐在會議室的圓桌旁。

examples.en: The bus takes a circular route around the park.
examples.zh: 這班公車繞著公園走環形路線。

examples.en: Their argument was circular and never reached an answer.
examples.zh: 他們的爭論是在原地打轉，始終沒有答案。

examples.en: The store sent out a circular about the summer sale.
examples.zh: 這家商店寄出了夏季特賣的傳單。

examples.en: A circular from the school was in my mailbox.
examples.zh: 我的信箱裡有一份學校寄來的通告。

examples.en: Please read the circular and sign the last page.
examples.zh: 請閱讀這份通告並在最後一頁簽名。

examples.en: Blood circulates through the body, carrying oxygen to our cells.
examples.zh: 血液在體內循環，把氧氣運送到細胞。

examples.en: Please circulate the report among all team members.
examples.zh: 請把這份報告在所有組員之間傳閱。

examples.en: A rumor about the exam began to circulate at school.
examples.zh: 一則關於考試的謠言開始在學校裡流傳。

examples.en: Walking every day improves blood circulation in the legs.
examples.zh: 每天走路能改善腿部的血液循環。

examples.en: The magazine has a circulation of about ten thousand copies.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌的發行量大約是一萬本。

examples.en: Fans in the room keep the air in circulation.
examples.zh: 房間裡的電扇讓空氣保持流通。

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you open this door.
examples.zh: 在任何情況下你都不該打開這扇門。

examples.en: The circumstances of the accident are still unclear.
examples.zh: 這起意外的情況仍不明朗。

examples.en: They lived in poor circumstances but never gave up.
examples.zh: 他們的生活環境很差，卻從未放棄。

examples.en: The museum is open to civilians on weekends.
examples.zh: 這間博物館週末開放給一般民眾參觀。

examples.en: After leaving the army, he lived as a civilian again.
examples.zh: 離開軍隊後，他再次以平民身分生活。

examples.en: Civilians in the area were told to stay calm.
examples.zh: 該地區的民眾被告知要保持冷靜。

examples.en: The airport serves both military and civilian flights.
examples.zh: 這座機場同時供軍用與民用航班使用。

examples.en: She wore civilian clothes on her day off.
examples.zh: 她休假那天穿的是便服。

examples.en: A civilian committee will review the new plan.
examples.zh: 一個民間委員會將審查這項新計畫。

examples.en: The ancient Egyptian civilization built great pyramids.
examples.zh: 古埃及文明建造了偉大的金字塔。

examples.en: The museum shows how civilization has changed over time.
examples.zh: 這間博物館展示了文明如何隨著時間改變。

examples.en: Writing was an important step in the growth of civilization.
examples.zh: 文字的發明是文明發展中重要的一步。

examples.en: Could you clarify what you mean by this sentence?
examples.zh: 你可以說明一下這個句子是什麼意思嗎？

examples.en: The teacher clarified the rules before the game began.
examples.zh: 老師在比賽開始前把規則說明清楚。

examples.en: The manager sent an email to clarify the new schedule.
examples.zh: 經理寄了一封電子郵件來釐清新的時間表。

examples.en: There was a clash of opinions at the club meeting.
examples.zh: 社團會議上出現了意見衝突。

examples.en: The two teams had a clash over the schedule.
examples.zh: 兩支隊伍為了時間表起了爭執。

examples.en: There is a clash between her yellow shirt and red skirt.
examples.zh: 她的黃襯衫和紅裙子配色不協調。

examples.en: My piano lesson clashes with the English class on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我的鋼琴課和星期二的英文課時間衝突。

examples.en: The two leaders often clash over how to spend the budget.
examples.zh: 這兩位領導者經常為了如何使用預算而起衝突。

examples.en: Those bright colors clash with the old curtains.
examples.zh: 那些鮮豔的顏色和舊窗簾很不搭。

examples.en: The classification of plants is based on their leaves and flowers.
examples.zh: 植物的分類是根據葉子和花來決定的。

examples.en: Please check the classification of each book before you shelve it.
examples.zh: 把每本書上架前，請先確認它的類別。

examples.en: The library uses a simple classification system.
examples.zh: 這間圖書館使用一套簡單的分類系統。

examples.en: Scientists classify animals into groups by their features.
examples.zh: 科學家依據特徵把動物分成不同的類別。

examples.en: The librarian will classify the new books by subject.
examples.zh: 圖書館員會依主題替新書分類。

examples.en: We classified the photos by date and place.
examples.zh: 我們依日期和地點把照片歸類。

examples.en: The cat sharpened its claws on the old sofa.
examples.zh: 那隻貓在舊沙發上磨牠的爪子。

examples.en: A crab can pinch you with its large claw.
examples.zh: 螃蟹會用牠的大螯夾人。

examples.en: The eagle held the fish in its claws.
examples.zh: 老鷹用爪子抓著那條魚。

examples.en: The kitten tried to claw its way up the curtain.
examples.zh: 那隻小貓試著用爪子攀上窗簾。

examples.en: The dog began to claw at the door to go outside.
examples.zh: 那隻狗開始用爪子扒門，想出去。

examples.en: He had to claw through the thick bushes to find the path.
examples.zh: 他得用手扒開濃密的灌木叢才找得到小徑。

examples.en: We stood on the cliff and watched the waves below.
examples.zh: 我們站在懸崖上，看著下方的海浪。

examples.en: A small path runs along the edge of the cliff.
examples.zh: 一條小路沿著懸崖邊緣延伸。

examples.en: Birds built their nests on the steep cliff.
examples.zh: 鳥兒在陡峭的懸崖上築巢。

senses.zh: 笨拙的；不靈巧的；不得體的

examples.en: I am so clumsy that I spilled my drink again.
examples.zh: 我太笨手笨腳了，又把飲料打翻了。

examples.en: The clumsy waiter dropped a plate in front of the guests.
examples.zh: 那位笨手笨腳的服務生在客人面前摔了一個盤子。

examples.en: He made a clumsy excuse for being late.
examples.zh: 他為遲到編了一個很拙劣的藉口。

examples.en: The towel felt coarse against my skin.
examples.zh: 這條毛巾貼在皮膚上感覺很粗糙。

examples.en: Use coarse salt to season the meat before cooking.
examples.zh: 烹煮前用粗鹽替肉調味。

examples.en: His coarse language shocked the teachers during the school meeting.
examples.zh: 學校會議期間，他粗俗的言詞讓老師們很震驚。

examples.en: Enter the secret code to open the door.
examples.zh: 輸入秘密密碼就能把門打開。

examples.en: The school has a dress code for all students.
examples.zh: 學校對所有學生都有服裝規定。

examples.en: She writes computer code for a small software company.
examples.zh: 她替一家小型軟體公司撰寫程式碼。

examples.en: My brother learned to code when he was twelve.
examples.zh: 我弟弟十二歲就學會寫程式了。

examples.en: They coded the messages so no one else could read them.
examples.zh: 他們把訊息編成密碼，這樣別人就看不懂。

examples.en: We will code the survey answers before we count them.
examples.zh: 我們會先把問卷答案編碼，再進行統計。

examples.en: The old bridge may collapse if the river keeps rising.
examples.zh: 如果河水持續上漲，這座老橋可能會倒塌。

examples.en: The runner collapsed at the finish line from the heat.
examples.zh: 那位跑者因為高溫在終點線倒下了。

examples.en: The small shop collapsed after the big store opened nearby.
examples.zh: 大型商店在附近開幕後，這間小店就倒閉了。

examples.en: The collapse of the roof surprised the neighbors.
examples.zh: 屋頂的倒塌讓鄰居們很驚訝。

examples.en: The collapse of the company hurt many workers.
examples.zh: 這間公司的垮台使許多員工受到影響。

examples.en: Doctors blamed his collapse on a lack of sleep.
examples.zh: 醫生認為他的昏倒是睡眠不足造成的。

examples.en: My colleague helped me finish the report before noon.
examples.zh: 我的同事幫我在中午前完成了報告。

examples.en: She invited a few colleagues to her birthday dinner.
examples.zh: 她邀請了幾位同事參加她的生日晚餐。

examples.en: I asked a colleague for advice about the new project.
examples.zh: 我向一位同事請教關於新專案的建議。

examples.en: Rice and beans make a healthy combination.
examples.zh: 米飯和豆子是很健康的搭配。

examples.en: The combination of rain and wind canceled the game.
examples.zh: 風雨交加導致比賽取消。

examples.en: I forgot the combination to my bike lock.
examples.zh: 我忘了腳踏車鎖的密碼組合。

examples.en: We watched a funny comedy on Saturday night.
examples.zh: 我們星期六晚上看了一部好笑的喜劇片。

examples.en: The drama club will perform a comedy next month.
examples.zh: 戲劇社下個月要演出一齣喜劇。

examples.en: Her speech was full of comedy and kept us laughing.
examples.zh: 她的演說充滿幽默，讓我們一直笑個不停。

examples.en: The commander gave clear orders to the whole team.
examples.zh: 指揮官向整個團隊下達了清楚的命令。

examples.en: A new commander arrived at the base yesterday.
examples.zh: 一位新的指揮官昨天抵達了基地。

examples.en: The commander of the ship thanked the crew.
examples.zh: 船艦的指揮官向全體船員道謝。

examples.en: Taipei is an important center of commerce in Asia.
examples.zh: 台北是亞洲重要的商業中心。

examples.en: The city grew quickly because of trade and commerce.
examples.zh: 這座城市因為貿易和商業而快速成長。

examples.en: Online commerce has changed the way we shop.
examples.zh: 網路商務改變了我們購物的方式。

examples.en: He committed an error when he added the numbers.
examples.zh: 他在加總數字時犯了一個錯誤。

examples.en: I commit to finishing the project by Friday.
examples.zh: 我承諾在星期五前完成這項專案。

examples.en: She committed herself to learning English every day.
examples.zh: 她下定決心每天學英文。

examples.en: Good communication helps a team work well together.
examples.zh: 良好的溝通能幫助團隊合作順利。

examples.en: Cell phones have made communication easier for everyone.
examples.zh: 手機讓每個人的聯絡都變得更容易。

examples.en: There was no communication between the two offices.
examples.zh: 這兩間辦公室之間沒有任何聯繫。

examples.en: Our community holds a clean-up day every spring.
examples.zh: 我們社區每年春天都會舉辦清潔日。

examples.en: The school is an important part of the community.
examples.zh: 學校是社區裡很重要的一部分。

examples.en: She joined an online community for bird lovers.
examples.zh: 她加入了一個賞鳥愛好者的網路社群。

examples.en: The dog was his loyal companion for twelve years.
examples.zh: 這隻狗陪伴了他十二年，是他忠實的夥伴。

examples.en: She found a travel companion for her trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 她找到了一位同行的旅伴，一起去日本。

examples.en: A good book can be a wonderful companion.
examples.zh: 一本好書可以是很棒的良伴。

examples.en: She won first prize in the speech competition.
examples.zh: 她在演講比賽中得到第一名。

examples.en: There is strong competition for jobs in this city.
examples.zh: 這座城市的工作競爭很激烈。

examples.en: The two stores are in competition for customers.
examples.zh: 這兩家店正在爭取客人。

senses.zh: 競爭的；好勝的；有競爭力的

examples.en: The job market is very competitive this year.
examples.zh: 今年的就業市場競爭非常激烈。

examples.en: My brother is competitive and hates to lose a game.
examples.zh: 我弟弟很好勝，討厭輸掉遊戲。

examples.en: The shop offers competitive prices on school supplies.
examples.zh: 這家店的學生用品價格很有競爭力。

examples.en: Our main competitor just lowered its prices.
examples.zh: 我們的主要競爭對手剛剛降價了。

examples.en: Each competitor must wear a number during the race.
examples.zh: 每位參賽者在比賽中都必須佩戴號碼。

examples.en: She studied her competitors before the interview.
examples.zh: 她在面試前研究了她的競爭對手。

examples.en: Too many rules will only complicate the process.
examples.zh: 太多規定只會讓流程變得複雜。

examples.en: Heavy traffic complicated our trip to the airport.
examples.zh: 嚴重的塞車讓我們前往機場的行程變得更麻煩。

examples.en: Please don't complicate things by changing the plan again.
examples.zh: 請不要再改計畫，讓事情更複雜了。

examples.en: Twelve students compose the school band that plays at every assembly.
examples.zh: 十二位學生組成了每次集會都會演奏的學校樂隊。

examples.en: He likes to compose songs on his guitar.
examples.zh: 他喜歡用吉他創作歌曲。

examples.en: She took a deep breath to compose herself before the speech.
examples.zh: 她在演講前深呼吸，讓自己鎮定下來。

examples.en: Mozart is one of the most famous composers in history.
examples.zh: 莫札特是歷史上最有名的作曲家之一。

examples.en: The composer wrote a new piece for the school orchestra.
examples.zh: 這位作曲家為學校管弦樂團寫了一首新曲子。

examples.en: My favorite composer was born in Germany.
examples.zh: 我最喜歡的作曲家出生在德國。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to write a short composition about summer.
examples.zh: 老師要我們寫一篇關於夏天的短文。

examples.en: Beethoven's last composition is still played around the world.
examples.zh: 貝多芬的最後一首作品至今仍在世界各地演奏。

examples.en: Scientists studied the chemical composition of the soil.
examples.zh: 科學家研究了土壤的化學成分。

examples.en: I can't concentrate when the room is so noisy.
examples.zh: 房間這麼吵，我沒辦法專心。

examples.en: Please concentrate on the first question of the test.
examples.zh: 請專心作答考卷的第一題。

examples.en: The city plans to concentrate new stores near the station.
examples.zh: 市府計畫把新的商店集中在車站附近。

examples.en: Mix the juice concentrate with cold water.
examples.zh: 把濃縮果汁和冷水混合。

examples.en: This soup is made from tomato concentrate.
examples.zh: 這道湯是用濃縮番茄製成的。

examples.en: Add a little concentrate to the cleaning water.
examples.zh: 在清潔用的水裡加一點濃縮液。

examples.en: Reading in a noisy room requires a lot of concentration.
examples.zh: 在吵鬧的房間裡閱讀需要很高的專注力。

examples.en: The concentration of salt in this water is quite high.
examples.zh: 這個水裡的鹽濃度相當高。

examples.en: Loud music can break your concentration while you study.
examples.zh: 讀書時，大聲的音樂會讓你分心。

examples.en: The teacher explained the concept of fractions with a pizza.
examples.zh: 老師用披薩來說明分數的概念。

examples.en: Time is a difficult concept for young children.
examples.zh: 時間對年幼的孩子來說是個很難懂的概念。

examples.en: The new store is based on a simple concept.
examples.zh: 這家新店是以一個簡單的概念為基礎。

examples.en: I have a question concerning your homework.
examples.zh: 我有一個關於你作業的問題。

examples.en: The school sent a letter concerning the field trip.
examples.zh: 學校寄出一封有關校外教學的信。

examples.en: Please read the notice concerning the new schedule.
examples.zh: 請閱讀關於新時間表的公告。

examples.en: The report showed some concerning results about air quality.
examples.zh: 這份報告顯示了一些令人擔憂的空氣品質結果。

examples.en: His low test scores are concerning to his parents.
examples.zh: 他的低分讓他的父母很擔心。

examples.en: It is concerning that so many students are tired.
examples.zh: 有這麼多學生疲倦，實在令人擔憂。

examples.en: The workers poured concrete to make a new sidewalk.
examples.zh: 工人澆灌混凝土來鋪設新的人行道。

examples.en: The old bridge is made of concrete and steel.
examples.zh: 這座老橋是用混凝土和鋼鐵建成的。

examples.en: Fresh concrete needs time to harden before it can support heavy loads.
examples.zh: 新澆置的混凝土需要時間硬化，才能承受重物。

senses.zh: 具體的；實際的；混凝土製的

examples.en: Please give me a concrete example of your idea.
examples.zh: 請給我一個你想法的具體例子。

examples.en: We need concrete plans before we start the project.
examples.zh: 在開始專案之前，我們需要具體的計畫。

examples.en: The house has a concrete floor in the garage.
examples.zh: 這棟房子的車庫有混凝土地板。

examples.en: The conductor raised his hands and the orchestra began to play.
examples.zh: 指揮舉起雙手，樂團便開始演奏。

examples.en: The train conductor checked every passenger's ticket.
examples.zh: 火車車掌檢查了每位乘客的車票。

examples.en: Copper is a good conductor of electricity.
examples.zh: 銅是很好的電導體。

examples.en: Our manager will attend a conference in Tokyo next week.
examples.zh: 我們的經理下週要去東京參加一場研討會。

examples.en: The teacher had a conference with Tom's parents after school.
examples.zh: 老師放學後與湯姆的父母會談。

examples.en: The conference room is on the third floor.
examples.zh: 會議室在三樓。

examples.en: I must confess that I forgot your birthday.
examples.zh: 我必須坦白，我忘了你的生日。

examples.en: The boy confessed that he had broken the window.
examples.zh: 那個男孩承認窗戶是他打破的。

examples.en: She confessed her mistake to the teacher right away.
examples.zh: 她立刻向老師承認了自己的錯誤。

examples.en: She spoke with confidence during the presentation.
examples.zh: 她在簡報時說話很有自信。

examples.en: Passing the exam gave him more confidence.
examples.zh: 通過考試讓他更有信心。

examples.en: The team has full confidence in its new coach.
examples.zh: 這支球隊對新教練充滿信心。

examples.en: There was some confusion about the meeting time.
examples.zh: 大家對開會時間有些困惑。

examples.en: The sudden rain caused confusion at the bus stop.
examples.zh: 突如其來的雨在公車站造成了一片混亂。

examples.en: To avoid confusion, please write your name clearly.
examples.zh: 為了避免混淆，請把你的名字寫清楚。

examples.en: I called my cousin to congratulate her on the new job.
examples.zh: 我打電話恭喜表姐得到新工作。

examples.en: The principal congratulated the students on their success.
examples.zh: 校長祝賀學生們的成功。

examples.en: Let's congratulate the winners with a big round of applause.
examples.zh: 讓我們用熱烈的掌聲向得獎者道賀。

examples.en: Congress passed a new law about school lunches.
examples.zh: 國會通過了一項關於學校午餐的新法律。

examples.en: The members of Congress met to discuss the budget.
examples.zh: 國會議員開會討論預算。

examples.en: Doctors from many countries attended the medical congress.
examples.zh: 來自許多國家的醫師參加了這場醫學大會。

examples.en: The army conquered the small island in the year 1200.
examples.zh: 這支軍隊在一二〇〇年征服了那座小島。

examples.en: She worked hard to conquer her fear of speaking in public.
examples.zh: 她努力克服對公開演講的恐懼。

examples.en: Climbers hope to conquer the highest mountain in the region.
examples.zh: 登山者希望征服這個地區最高的山。

examples.en: He had a guilty conscience after telling a lie.
examples.zh: 他說謊之後良心不安。

examples.en: My conscience told me to return the lost wallet.
examples.zh: 我的良心告訴我要把遺失的皮夾還回去。

examples.en: She has a clear conscience because she did her best.
examples.zh: 她問心無愧，因為她已經盡了全力。

examples.en: Skipping breakfast can have a bad consequence for your health.
examples.zh: 不吃早餐可能對你的健康造成不良後果。

examples.en: As a consequence of the storm, the train was late.
examples.zh: 因為暴風雨的緣故，火車誤點了。

examples.en: Whether we go today or tomorrow is of little consequence.
examples.zh: 我們今天或明天去都沒什麼關係。

senses.zh: 隨之而來的；因而發生的

examples.en: The factory closed, and the consequent loss of jobs hurt the town.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉了，隨之而來的失業傷害了這個小鎮。

examples.en: Heavy rain and the consequent flooding closed the road.
examples.zh: 大雨以及隨之而來的淹水讓道路封閉了。

examples.en: The rise in prices and the consequent drop in sales worried the owner.
examples.zh: 物價上漲以及隨之而來的銷量下滑讓老闆很擔心。

senses.zh: 保守的；守舊的；保守估計的

examples.en: My grandfather has a conservative view of fashion.
examples.zh: 我爺爺對時尚抱持保守的看法。

examples.en: The company took a conservative approach to spending money.
examples.zh: 這家公司對花錢採取保守的做法。

examples.en: A conservative estimate says about two hundred people will come.
examples.zh: 保守估計約有兩百人會來。

examples.en: My uncle is a conservative who dislikes quick changes.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是個不喜歡快速改變的保守派人士。

examples.en: The conservatives in the group voted against the new plan.
examples.zh: 小組裡的保守派人士投票反對新計畫。

examples.en: She is a conservative when it comes to spending money.
examples.zh: 在花錢這件事上，她是個保守的人。

examples.en: The team consists of ten students from three classes.
examples.zh: 這個團隊由來自三個班級的十名學生組成。

examples.en: A good breakfast consists of eggs, toast and fruit.
examples.zh: 一份好的早餐包含蛋、吐司和水果。

examples.en: The beauty of this town consists in its quiet streets.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮的美就在於它安靜的街道。

senses.zh: 一致的；始終如一的；穩定的

examples.en: The coach wants consistent effort from every player.
examples.zh: 教練希望每位球員都能持續不斷地努力。

examples.en: Her story is consistent with what the other students said.
examples.zh: 她的說法與其他學生所說的一致。

examples.en: He has been a consistent student with good grades all year.
examples.zh: 他一整年都是成績穩定的好學生。

examples.en: Girls constitute half of the students in our school.
examples.zh: 女生占了我們學校一半的學生。

examples.en: Twelve months constitute one year in the calendar we use.
examples.zh: 在我們使用的曆法中，十二個月構成一年。

examples.en: Copying another student's answers constitutes cheating, even during a short quiz.
examples.zh: 即使是小考，抄襲其他同學的答案也算作弊。

examples.en: The constitution protects the rights of all citizens.
examples.zh: 憲法保障所有公民的權利。

examples.en: My grandmother has a strong constitution and rarely gets sick.
examples.zh: 我奶奶體質很好，很少生病。

examples.en: The students studied the constitution of the new club.
examples.zh: 學生們研究了新社團的章程。

examples.en: The city plans to construct a new library near the park.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫在公園附近興建一座新圖書館。

examples.en: Students used paper and glue to construct a model bridge.
examples.zh: 學生們用紙和膠水做出一座橋的模型。

examples.en: He tried to construct a clear sentence in English.
examples.zh: 他試著組成一個清楚的英文句子。

examples.en: Time is a social construct that people agreed on long ago.
examples.zh: 時間是人們很久以前共同接受的一種社會建構。

examples.en: The idea of a perfect student is just a mental construct.
examples.zh: 完美學生的想法只是一種心理上的構想。

examples.en: Teachers discussed how language is a human construct.
examples.zh: 老師們討論了語言如何是一種人為的建構。

examples.en: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
examples.zh: 這座新橋的建造花了兩年。

examples.en: There is a lot of construction on our street this month.
examples.zh: 這個月我們這條街有很多施工。

examples.en: The toy's simple construction makes it easy to repair.
examples.zh: 這個玩具的結構簡單，所以很容易修理。

examples.en: The teacher gave me constructive advice on my essay.
examples.zh: 老師給了我關於作文的建設性建議。

examples.en: We had a constructive meeting and solved the problem.
examples.zh: 我們開了一場有建設性的會議，解決了問題。

examples.en: Constructive criticism helps students improve their work.
examples.zh: 有建設性的批評能幫助學生改進作品。

examples.en: The company hired a consultant to improve its website.
examples.zh: 這家公司聘請了一位顧問來改善網站。

examples.en: My aunt works as a financial consultant at a bank.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在銀行擔任財務顧問。

examples.en: The hospital asked a consultant to review the plan.
examples.zh: 醫院請了一位顧問來審查這份計畫。

examples.en: This old car consumes a lot of gas.
examples.zh: 這輛老車非常耗油。

examples.en: Teenagers often consume too much sugar every week.
examples.zh: 青少年每週攝取的糖分往往過多。

examples.en: Video games consumed most of his free time.
examples.zh: 電玩占去了他大部分的空閒時間。

examples.en: Consumers are buying more products online than before.
examples.zh: 消費者在網路上購買的產品比以前更多。

examples.en: The store lowered its prices to attract consumers.
examples.zh: 這家店降低價格來吸引消費者。

examples.en: A smart consumer compares prices before buying.
examples.zh: 聰明的消費者在購買前會比較價格。

examples.en: Please put the leftover soup in a plastic container.
examples.zh: 請把剩下的湯裝進塑膠容器裡。

examples.en: The ship carried hundreds of containers across the ocean.
examples.zh: 這艘船載著數百個貨櫃橫越海洋。

examples.en: Keep the rice in a container with a tight lid.
examples.zh: 把米放在有緊密蓋子的容器裡。

examples.en: The content of the speech was easy to understand.
examples.zh: 這場演講的內容很容易理解。

examples.en: This drink has a low sugar content.
examples.zh: 這種飲料的含糖量很低。

examples.en: Many websites offer free video content for students learning English.
examples.zh: 許多網站提供免費的影片內容，供學英文的學生使用。

examples.en: The cat looked content as it slept in the sun.
examples.zh: 那隻貓在陽光下睡覺，看起來很滿足。

examples.en: He is content with a simple life in the countryside.
examples.zh: 他對鄉下簡單的生活感到滿足。

examples.en: She was content to wait for the next bus.
examples.zh: 她願意安心等下一班公車。

examples.en: Our class won the singing contest last Friday.
examples.zh: 我們班在上週五的歌唱比賽中獲勝。

examples.en: She entered a writing contest at the library.
examples.zh: 她報名參加了圖書館的寫作比賽。

examples.en: The contest is open to all students in the school.
examples.zh: 這場比賽開放給學校所有學生參加。

examples.en: Three teams will contest the championship this weekend.
examples.zh: 三支隊伍本週末將爭奪冠軍。

examples.en: The company decided to contest the decision in court.
examples.zh: 公司決定向法院對這項決定提出異議。

examples.en: Students may contest their grades if they find a mistake.
examples.zh: 如果學生發現錯誤，可以對成績提出異議。

examples.en: You can guess the meaning of a new word from its context.
examples.zh: 你可以從上下文猜出新單字的意思。

examples.en: The teacher explained the historical context of the poem.
examples.zh: 老師說明了這首詩的歷史背景。

examples.en: His joke sounded rude when taken out of context.
examples.zh: 他的玩笑被斷章取義後聽起來很無禮。

senses.zh: 接二連三的；頻繁的；不斷重複的

examples.en: The continual noise from the street kept me awake.
examples.zh: 街上不斷傳來的噪音讓我睡不著。

examples.en: Continual phone calls interrupted our dinner, so we turned off the phone.
examples.zh: 接二連三的電話打斷了我們的晚餐，因此我們關掉了電話。

examples.en: Her continual questions made the teacher smile.
examples.zh: 她一再提出的問題讓老師笑了。

examples.en: There was a continuous line of cars on the highway.
examples.zh: 高速公路上的車輛連成一條長龍。

examples.en: The machine needs a continuous supply of water.
examples.zh: 這台機器需要持續不斷的水供應。

examples.en: We heard continuous rain throughout the night.
examples.zh: 我們整夜都聽見持續不斷的雨聲。

examples.en: The two students had contrary opinions about the plan.
examples.zh: 這兩位學生對這個計畫的意見相反。

examples.en: The wind blew in a direction contrary to the boat's path.
examples.zh: 風吹的方向與船的航道相反。

examples.en: Contrary ideas made the discussion more interesting.
examples.zh: 相互對立的想法讓討論變得更有趣。

examples.en: I thought the test would be hard, but the contrary was true.
examples.zh: 我以為考試會很難，結果正好相反。

examples.en: On the contrary, I enjoyed the long trip.
examples.zh: 正好相反，我很喜歡這趟長途旅行。

examples.en: Unless you hear the contrary, meet us at six.
examples.zh: 除非你聽到相反的消息，否則請六點和我們碰面。

examples.en: There is a clear contrast between the two brothers.
examples.zh: 這兩兄弟之間有明顯的差異。

examples.en: The black-and-white photo shows a strong contrast between light and shadow.
examples.zh: 這張黑白照片呈現出光影之間強烈的對比。

examples.en: In contrast to his sister, Ben loves to cook.
examples.zh: 與他姊姊相反，班很愛下廚。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to contrast city life with country life.
examples.zh: 老師要我們對照都市生活與鄉村生活。

examples.en: Her bright coat contrasts with the gray sky.
examples.zh: 她鮮豔的外套與灰色的天空形成對比。

examples.en: The report contrasts the prices of the two stores.
examples.zh: 這份報告比較了兩家商店的價格。

examples.en: Every student contributed ten dollars to the class party.
examples.zh: 每位學生都捐了十元給班上的派對。

examples.en: Regular exercise contributes to good health by keeping our bodies active.
examples.zh: 規律運動讓身體保持活躍，有助於身體健康。

examples.en: She contributes an article to the school newspaper each month.
examples.zh: 她每個月都為校刊投稿一篇文章。

examples.en: Everyone made a contribution to the success of the event.
examples.zh: 每個人都為活動的成功作出了貢獻。

examples.en: The school welcomes your contribution to the book fund.
examples.zh: 學校歡迎你捐款給圖書基金。

examples.en: Her contribution to the magazine was a short story.
examples.zh: 她投給雜誌的稿件是一篇短篇故事。

examples.en: Online shopping offers great convenience for busy people.
examples.zh: 網路購物為忙碌的人提供了很大的便利。

examples.en: For your convenience, the store opens at seven.
examples.zh: 為了方便您，這家店七點就開門。

examples.en: The hotel has every modern convenience, including free Wi-Fi.
examples.zh: 這間旅館有各種現代化的便利設施，包括免費無線網路。

examples.en: The comic book convention attracts thousands of fans each year.
examples.zh: 漫畫大會每年吸引數千名粉絲。

examples.en: It is a social convention to say thank you.
examples.zh: 說謝謝是一種社會慣例。

examples.en: Many countries signed the convention to protect the ocean.
examples.zh: 許多國家簽署了保護海洋的公約。

examples.en: My parents prefer a conventional wedding in a church.
examples.zh: 我父母偏好在教堂舉行傳統的婚禮。

examples.en: The restaurant serves conventional dishes with a modern twist.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳供應傳統菜色，並加入現代的變化。

examples.en: She chose a conventional career as a teacher.
examples.zh: 她選擇了教師這個傳統的職業。

examples.en: The two students conversed quietly in the library.
examples.zh: 那兩位學生在圖書館裡輕聲交談。

examples.en: I enjoy conversing with tourists in English.
examples.zh: 我喜歡用英文和觀光客交談。

examples.en: The guests conversed for hours after dinner.
examples.zh: 客人們在晚餐後交談了好幾個小時。

examples.en: A smile can convey a friendly message without any words.
examples.zh: 微笑不用言語就能傳達友善的訊息。

examples.en: Please convey my thanks to your parents.
examples.zh: 請代我向你的父母轉達謝意。

examples.en: A long belt conveys the boxes to the truck.
examples.zh: 一條長長的輸送帶把箱子運到卡車上。

examples.en: I could not convince my brother to join the club.
examples.zh: 我沒辦法說服我弟弟加入社團。

examples.en: The salesperson convinced us to buy the larger size.
examples.zh: 店員說服我們買比較大的尺寸。

examples.en: Her clear answer convinced the teacher that she was right.
examples.zh: 她清楚的回答讓老師確信她是對的。

examples.en: Students must cooperate to finish the group project.
examples.zh: 學生們必須合作才能完成小組專題。

examples.en: The two companies agreed to cooperate on a new product.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司同意合作開發新產品。

examples.en: Please cooperate with the staff during the fire drill.
examples.zh: 消防演習時請配合工作人員。

examples.en: The project succeeded because of everyone's cooperation.
examples.zh: 這個專案能成功是因為大家的合作。

examples.en: Thank you for your cooperation during the check-in.
examples.zh: 感謝您在報到時的配合。

examples.en: Close cooperation between teachers and parents helps children learn.
examples.zh: 老師與家長的密切合作有助於孩子學習。

examples.en: The children were cooperative and cleaned the room quickly.
examples.zh: 孩子們很願意配合，很快就把房間打掃乾淨。

examples.en: We need a cooperative team to win this game.
examples.zh: 我們需要一支願意合作的團隊才能贏得這場比賽。

examples.en: The manager thanked the cooperative staff for working late.
examples.zh: 經理感謝樂意配合、加班到很晚的員工。

examples.en: My uncle sells fruit through a farmers' cooperative.
examples.zh: 我叔叔透過農民合作社銷售水果。

examples.en: The cooperative buys rice from local farmers.
examples.zh: 這家合作社向當地農民收購稻米。

examples.en: She joined a food cooperative to save money.
examples.zh: 她加入了一個食品合作社來省錢。

examples.en: It is hard to cope with so much homework.
examples.zh: 要應付這麼多功課很困難。

examples.en: She learned to cope with stress by taking a walk.
examples.zh: 她學會用散步來因應壓力。

examples.en: The small shop could not cope with the crowd.
examples.zh: 這家小店應付不了那麼多人潮。

examples.en: Copper is often used to make electrical wires.
examples.zh: 銅常被用來製作電線。

examples.en: The old pot was made of copper.
examples.zh: 這個舊鍋子是用銅做的。

examples.en: He found a few old coppers in the bottom drawer.
examples.zh: 他在最底下的抽屜裡找到幾枚舊銅幣。

examples.en: She wore a copper bracelet on her left arm.
examples.zh: 她的左手臂戴著一只銅手環。

examples.en: The kitchen has a set of copper pans.
examples.zh: 這間廚房有一組銅製平底鍋。

examples.en: The leaves turned a copper color in autumn.
examples.zh: 樹葉在秋天變成了銅色。

examples.en: Please plug the cord into the wall socket.
examples.zh: 請把電線插進牆上的插座。

examples.en: He tied the box with a strong cord.
examples.zh: 他用一條堅韌的細繩把箱子綁起來。

examples.en: Don't pull the phone charger by its cord.
examples.zh: 不要拉著充電線來拔手機充電器。

examples.en: Your answer does not correspond with the one in the book.
examples.zh: 你的答案與書上的答案不相符。

examples.en: She corresponds with a pen pal in Canada.
examples.zh: 她和一位加拿大的筆友通信。

examples.en: The numbers on the map correspond to the places in the list.
examples.zh: 地圖上的數字對應清單上的地點。

examples.en: She wore a witch costume to the Halloween party.
examples.zh: 她穿著女巫裝去參加萬聖節派對。

examples.en: The actors changed into their costumes before the show.
examples.zh: 演員們在演出前換上了戲服。

examples.en: The museum has a display of traditional costumes.
examples.zh: 這間博物館展示著傳統服飾。

examples.en: We rented a small cottage near the lake for the weekend.
examples.zh: 我們週末在湖邊租了一間小屋。

examples.en: The old cottage has a garden full of roses.
examples.zh: 那間老小屋有個種滿玫瑰的花園。

examples.en: Grandma's cottage is only a short walk from the beach.
examples.zh: 奶奶的小屋離海灘只有一小段路。

examples.en: The city council will vote on the new bus route next week.
examples.zh: 市議會下週將就新的公車路線進行表決。

examples.en: Our school student council organizes a book fair every year.
examples.zh: 我們學校的學生會每年都舉辦書展。

examples.en: The council asked residents to share their opinions about the park.
examples.zh: 委員會請居民針對公園提出意見。

examples.en: Please pay for your drinks at the counter.
examples.zh: 請到櫃檯付飲料的錢。

examples.en: She put the groceries on the kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 她把雜貨放在廚房的檯面上。

examples.en: The machine has a counter that shows how many people enter.
examples.zh: 這台機器有個計數器，顯示進入的人數。

examples.en: The lawyer tried to counter every argument with clear facts.
examples.zh: 律師試著用明確的事實反駁每一項論點。

examples.en: The company hopes a new ad will counter the drop in sales.
examples.zh: 公司希望新廣告能抵銷銷售量的下滑。

examples.en: He countered that the plan would cost too much.
examples.zh: 他反駁說這個計畫花費太高。

examples.en: The courageous girl spoke up when she saw someone being treated unfairly.
examples.zh: 那個勇敢的女孩看到有人被不公平對待時挺身而出。

examples.en: It was courageous of him to admit his mistake in front of everyone.
examples.zh: 他在大家面前承認錯誤，真是有勇氣。

examples.en: The firefighters were courageous during the flood.
examples.zh: 消防員在水災期間表現得很勇敢。

examples.en: Please show courtesy to other passengers on the bus.
examples.zh: 請對公車上的其他乘客保持禮貌。

examples.en: The hotel gave us a free breakfast as a courtesy.
examples.zh: 飯店免費招待我們早餐作為一份好意。

examples.en: He thanked her for the courtesy of holding the door.
examples.zh: 他感謝她好心為他扶著門。

examples.en: He felt like a coward for running away from the problem.
examples.zh: 他覺得自己逃避問題像個懦夫。

examples.en: Don't be a coward; just tell the teacher the truth.
examples.zh: 別當膽小鬼，把實情告訴老師吧。

examples.en: Nobody wants to be called a coward in front of friends.
examples.zh: 沒有人想在朋友面前被叫做膽小鬼。

examples.en: There is a long crack in the bedroom wall.
examples.zh: 臥室牆上有一道長長的裂縫。

examples.en: Water leaked through a crack in the pipe.
examples.zh: 水從水管的裂縫漏了出來。

examples.en: We heard a loud crack of thunder just before the rain.
examples.zh: 下雨前，我們聽到一聲響亮的雷鳴。

examples.en: Be careful not to crack the eggs too hard.
examples.zh: 打蛋時小心別太用力敲開蛋殼。

examples.en: The ice began to crack under our feet.
examples.zh: 我們腳下的冰開始裂開。

examples.en: It took the team weeks to crack the code.
examples.zh: 團隊花了好幾週才破解這組密碼。

examples.en: Making paper lanterns is a popular craft for children.
examples.zh: 製作紙燈籠是很受孩子歡迎的手工藝。

examples.en: The village is famous for its traditional crafts.
examples.zh: 這個村莊以傳統工藝聞名。

examples.en: Writing a good story is a craft that takes years to learn.
examples.zh: 寫出好故事是一門要花好幾年學習的技藝。

examples.en: She crafted a small boat from a piece of wood.
examples.zh: 她用一塊木頭精心做了一艘小船。

examples.en: The teacher crafted a clear lesson plan for the class.
examples.zh: 老師為班上精心擬定了清楚的教案。

examples.en: The designer crafts each bag by hand.
examples.zh: 設計師親手製作每一個包包。

examples.en: The creation of this website took our team six months.
examples.zh: 我們團隊花了六個月建立這個網站。

examples.en: Her latest creation is a dress made of recycled paper.
examples.zh: 她最新的作品是一件用回收紙做的洋裝。

examples.en: The artist was proud of his creation.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家為自己的創作感到驕傲。

senses.zh: 爬行；躡手躡腳地走；緩緩蔓延

examples.en: The baby began to creep across the floor toward her toy.
examples.zh: 寶寶開始朝著玩具爬過地板。

examples.en: I tried to creep into the room without waking my brother.
examples.zh: 我試著躡手躡腳走進房間，不吵醒我哥哥。

examples.en: Fog began to creep over the hills in the evening.
examples.zh: 傍晚時，霧氣開始緩緩漫過山丘。

examples.en: The film critic gave the movie four stars.
examples.zh: 這位影評人給了這部電影四顆星。

examples.en: Critics praised the new restaurant for its fresh food.
examples.zh: 評論家稱讚這間新餐廳的食物新鮮。

examples.en: He is a harsh critic of his own work.
examples.zh: 他是自己作品的嚴厲批評者。

examples.en: Our teacher was critical of the way I wrote my essay.
examples.zh: 老師對我寫文章的方式持批評態度。

examples.en: Sleep is critical for students who are preparing for exams.
examples.zh: 對準備考試的學生來說，睡眠至關重要。

examples.en: The patient is in critical condition and needs care right away.
examples.zh: 這位病人病情危急，需要立刻照護。

examples.en: He accepted the criticism and promised to do better.
examples.zh: 他接受了批評，並承諾會做得更好。

examples.en: The new policy received a lot of criticism online.
examples.zh: 新政策在網路上受到許多批評。

examples.en: Good teachers give criticism in a kind way.
examples.zh: 好老師會用親切的方式給予批評。

examples.en: Please don't criticize others without knowing the whole story.
examples.zh: 在不了解整個來龍去脈前，請不要批評別人。

examples.en: The newspaper criticized the mayor for ignoring the traffic problem.
examples.zh: 報紙批評市長忽視交通問題。

examples.en: My coach never criticizes us in front of the team.
examples.zh: 教練從不在全隊面前批評我們。

examples.en: Animal cruelty is against the law in many countries.
examples.zh: 虐待動物在許多國家是違法的。

examples.en: She was shocked by the cruelty of the comments.
examples.zh: 她被這些留言的殘忍嚇到了。

examples.en: The story teaches children to stand against cruelty.
examples.zh: 這個故事教導孩子反對殘忍的行為。

examples.en: Crush the garlic before you add it to the pan.
examples.zh: 把大蒜壓碎後再放進鍋裡。

examples.en: Don't put heavy books on the box or you will crush it.
examples.zh: 別把重書放在盒子上，否則會把它壓壞。

examples.en: He crushed the empty can and threw it in the recycling bin.
examples.zh: 他把空罐壓扁，丟進回收桶。

examples.en: She has a crush on a boy in her class.
examples.zh: 她暗戀班上的一個男生。

examples.en: Having a crush can make you feel nervous and happy at once.
examples.zh: 有暗戀的對象會讓你同時感到緊張又開心。

examples.en: His first crush was his English teacher.
examples.zh: 他第一個迷戀的對象是英文老師。

examples.en: The speaker waited for a cue before starting the music.
examples.zh: 講者等到有提示才開始播放音樂。

examples.en: Her yawn was a cue that it was time to leave.
examples.zh: 她打哈欠是暗示該離開了。

examples.en: Actors learn to follow every cue from the director.
examples.zh: 演員學著跟隨導演的每個提示。

examples.en: The cunning fox found a way into the chicken house.
examples.zh: 那隻狡猾的狐狸找到了進入雞舍的路。

examples.en: He made a cunning plan to win the game.
examples.zh: 他想出一個巧妙的計畫來贏得比賽。

examples.en: The shop owner was too cunning to be fooled.
examples.zh: 這位店主太精明了，不會被騙。

examples.en: Curiosity led the boy to open the old box.
examples.zh: 好奇心促使那個男孩打開了舊箱子。

examples.en: She read the sign out of curiosity.
examples.zh: 她出於好奇讀了那個告示。

examples.en: Children are full of curiosity about the world.
examples.zh: 孩子對世界充滿好奇心。

examples.en: She likes to curl her hair before going out.
examples.zh: 她出門前喜歡把頭髮弄捲。

examples.en: The cat curled up on the sofa and fell asleep.
examples.zh: 貓咪蜷縮在沙發上睡著了。

examples.en: Smoke curled up from the chimney into the cold morning air.
examples.zh: 煙從煙囪盤旋而上，飄入清晨冰冷的空氣中。

examples.en: The baby has soft curls on her head.
examples.zh: 這個小寶寶的頭上有柔軟的捲髮。

examples.en: He combed a curl of hair away from his face.
examples.zh: 他用梳子把一綹捲髮從臉前梳開。

examples.en: A curl of smoke rose from the campfire.
examples.zh: 一縷捲曲的煙從營火升起。

examples.en: In the story, a curse turned the prince into a frog.
examples.zh: 故事裡，一道詛咒把王子變成青蛙。

examples.en: The villagers believed the old house carried a curse.
examples.zh: 村民相信那棟老房子帶有詛咒。

examples.en: The kind wizard finally broke the curse.
examples.zh: 善良的巫師終於解除了詛咒。

examples.en: He cursed when he dropped his phone in the sink.
examples.zh: 他把手機掉進水槽時咒罵了一聲。

examples.en: In the tale, the witch cursed the village with endless rain.
examples.zh: 故事裡，女巫詛咒村子下個不停的雨。

examples.en: Don't curse at the referee; it is not polite.
examples.zh: 別對裁判咒罵，這樣不禮貌。

examples.en: She put a cushion behind her back on the sofa.
examples.zh: 她在沙發上把一個靠墊放在背後。

examples.en: The kids sat on cushions on the floor.
examples.zh: 孩子們坐在地板的坐墊上。

examples.en: This chair needs a softer cushion to support my back.
examples.zh: 這張椅子需要更軟的靠墊來支撐我的背部。

examples.en: A thick mat will cushion your fall in gym class.
examples.zh: 你在體育課跌倒時，厚墊子能減輕衝擊。

examples.en: Savings can cushion the impact of losing a job.
examples.zh: 存款能減輕失業帶來的衝擊。

examples.en: Foam cushions the camera inside the box.
examples.zh: 泡棉為盒內的相機提供緩衝。

examples.en: The towel is still damp, so don't put it away.
examples.zh: 毛巾還是濕的，先別收起來。

examples.en: It was a cold, damp morning in the mountains.
examples.zh: 那是山裡一個又冷又潮濕的早晨。

examples.en: Wipe the table with a damp cloth.
examples.zh: 用一塊微濕的布擦桌子。

examples.en: The deadline for the report is next Friday.
examples.zh: 這份報告的截止日期是下週五。

examples.en: We worked late to meet the deadline.
examples.zh: 我們工作到很晚，為的是趕上截止期限。

examples.en: Please send me an email if you need to extend the deadline.
examples.zh: 如果需要延長期限，請寄電子郵件給我。

examples.en: The principal declared that school would end early on Friday.
examples.zh: 校長宣布週五提早放學。

examples.en: Please declare any fruit or meat at customs.
examples.zh: 請在海關申報任何水果或肉類。

examples.en: The mayor declared the festival open after a short speech.
examples.zh: 市長發表簡短演說後，宣布慶典開始。

examples.en: We put up decorations in the classroom for the party.
examples.zh: 我們為了派對在教室裡佈置了裝飾品。

examples.en: The living room needs more decoration before our guests arrive.
examples.zh: 客人抵達前，客廳需要再多加一些裝飾。

examples.en: Red lanterns are a popular decoration during the Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 紅燈籠是農曆新年期間很受歡迎的裝飾。

examples.en: Our school team defeated the other school in the final.
examples.zh: 我們校隊在決賽中擊敗了另一所學校。

examples.en: She defeated her fear of speaking in public.
examples.zh: 她戰勝了對公開演講的恐懼。

examples.en: The chess club hopes to defeat last year's champion.
examples.zh: 西洋棋社希望擊敗去年的冠軍。

examples.en: The team accepted its defeat with a smile.
examples.zh: 球隊面帶微笑接受了失敗。

examples.en: Defeat taught him to practice harder before the next tennis match.
examples.zh: 失敗教會他在下一場網球賽前要更努力練習。

examples.en: After three defeats in a row, the coach changed the plan.
examples.zh: 連續三次敗北後，教練改變了策略。

examples.en: The goalkeeper's job is to defend the goal.
examples.zh: 守門員的工作是防守球門。

examples.en: She defended her opinion with clear examples.
examples.zh: 她用清楚的例子為自己的意見辯護。

examples.en: Many people work to defend the rights of children.
examples.zh: 許多人努力捍衛兒童的權利。

examples.en: Our team's defense was strong in the second half.
examples.zh: 我們隊的防守在下半場很強。

examples.en: Good locks are a simple defense against theft.
examples.zh: 好鎖是防範竊盜的簡單防禦方式。

examples.en: The lawyer presented a clear defense in court.
examples.zh: 律師在法庭上提出了清楚的辯護。

senses.zh: 防守的；戒備的；防禦性的

examples.en: He became defensive when we asked about his grade.
examples.zh: 當我們問起他的成績時，他變得很戒備。

examples.en: The coach practiced defensive plays with the team.
examples.zh: 教練和球隊練習防守戰術。

examples.en: Defensive driving can help prevent accidents on busy city roads.
