examples.zh: 防禦性駕駛有助於預防繁忙市區道路上的事故。

examples.en: We need a definite answer by Friday.
examples.zh: 我們週五前需要一個明確的答覆。

examples.en: There is a definite improvement in your writing.
examples.zh: 你的寫作有明顯的進步。

examples.en: Nothing is definite yet, so please wait.
examples.zh: 目前還沒有任何事確定，請稍候。

examples.en: Please handle the delicate glass cups with care.
examples.zh: 請小心處理這些易碎的玻璃杯。

examples.en: She wore a delicate silver necklace to her sister's wedding.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條精緻的銀項鍊參加姊姊的婚禮。

examples.en: Talking about money with friends can be a delicate matter.
examples.zh: 和朋友談錢可能是個微妙的問題。

examples.en: The children screamed with delight when they saw the snow.
examples.zh: 孩子們看到雪，開心地尖叫起來。

examples.en: Reading in the garden is one of her simple delights.
examples.zh: 在花園裡看書是她簡單的樂事之一。

examples.en: To my delight, the exam was easier than I expected.
examples.zh: 讓我高興的是，考試比我預期的簡單。

examples.en: The magic show delighted the young audience.
examples.zh: 魔術表演讓年輕的觀眾非常開心。

examples.en: Her cooking never fails to delight our guests.
examples.zh: 她做的菜總是能讓客人們開心。

examples.en: The gift will surely delight your grandmother.
examples.zh: 這份禮物一定會讓你奶奶很高興。

senses.zh: 令人愉快的；討人喜歡的

examples.en: We had a delightful evening with our neighbors.
examples.zh: 我們和鄰居度過了一個愉快的夜晚。

examples.en: What a delightful surprise to see you here!
examples.zh: 在這裡見到你，真是個令人開心的驚喜！

examples.en: The hotel serves a delightful breakfast on the terrace.
examples.zh: 這間飯店在露台供應令人愉快的早餐。

examples.en: There is a high demand for fresh fruit in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天對新鮮水果的需求很高。

examples.en: The workers made a demand for shorter hours.
examples.zh: 員工們提出縮短工時的要求。

examples.en: Parents' demands can sometimes feel like too much pressure.
examples.zh: 父母的要求有時會讓人覺得壓力太大。

examples.en: The customer demanded a refund for the broken toy.
examples.zh: 顧客要求為壞掉的玩具退款。

examples.en: This job demands patience and careful work.
examples.zh: 這份工作需要耐心與細心。

examples.en: The teacher demanded that everyone stay quiet.
examples.zh: 老師要求大家保持安靜。

examples.en: The chef will demonstrate how to make dumplings.
examples.zh: 主廚將示範如何包水餃。

examples.en: The test results demonstrate that the new method works.
examples.zh: 測驗結果證明這個新方法有效。

examples.en: Students can demonstrate their skills in the talent show.
examples.zh: 學生可以在才藝表演中展現他們的技能。

examples.en: The teacher gave a demonstration of the science experiment.
examples.zh: 老師示範了這個科學實驗。

examples.en: The product demonstration starts at two o'clock.
examples.zh: 產品展示會在兩點開始。

examples.en: Students held a peaceful demonstration to ask for safer roads near school.
examples.zh: 學生舉行和平示威，要求改善學校附近的道路安全。

examples.en: A dense fog covered the highway this morning.
examples.zh: 今早濃霧籠罩了公路。

examples.en: Tokyo is a dense city with many tall buildings.
examples.zh: 東京是個人口稠密、高樓林立的城市。

examples.en: The dense forest blocked most of the sunlight.
examples.zh: 茂密的森林擋住了大部分陽光。

examples.en: The train departs from platform three at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 火車九點從三號月台出發。

examples.en: The tourists departed from the hotel after breakfast this morning.
examples.zh: 遊客們今天早上吃完早餐後便離開飯店。

examples.en: We plan to depart for Tokyo early tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我們打算明天一早出發前往東京。

examples.en: Our flight's departure was delayed by an hour.
examples.zh: 我們班機的出發時間延後了一小時。

examples.en: Please check the departure time on your ticket.
examples.zh: 請確認機票上的出發時間。

examples.en: His sudden departure surprised everyone at the office.
examples.zh: 他突然離開讓辦公室的每個人都很驚訝。

senses.zh: 依賴的；由其他因素決定的

examples.en: Young children are dependent on their parents.
examples.zh: 年幼的孩子依賴他們的父母。

examples.en: Our picnic is dependent on the weather.
examples.zh: 我們的野餐要視天氣而定。

examples.en: Many small shops are dependent on tourists.
examples.zh: 許多小店依賴觀光客。

examples.en: Depression can make simple tasks feel very hard.
examples.zh: 憂鬱會讓簡單的事情變得很困難。

examples.en: Talking to a counselor can help with depression.
examples.zh: 和輔導老師談談可以幫助改善憂鬱。

examples.en: The country suffered a long economic depression in the 1930s.
examples.zh: 這個國家在 1930 年代經歷了長期的經濟蕭條。

examples.en: You deserve a rest after working so hard.
examples.zh: 你工作這麼努力，應該好好休息。

examples.en: Every child deserves a safe place to learn.
examples.zh: 每個孩子都值得擁有安全的學習環境。

examples.en: The team deserved to win after all that practice.
examples.zh: 經過那麼多練習，這支隊伍值得獲勝。

examples.en: The lost hiker was desperate for water.
examples.zh: 迷路的登山客迫切需要水。

examples.en: They made a desperate attempt to catch the last train.
examples.zh: 他們拚命想趕上最後一班火車。

examples.en: She felt desperate when she couldn't find her passport.
examples.zh: 找不到護照時，她感到絕望。

examples.en: We went to the park despite the rain.
examples.zh: 儘管下雨，我們還是去了公園。

examples.en: Despite his age, grandpa climbs the stairs every morning.
examples.zh: 儘管年紀大了，爺爺每天早上仍爬樓梯。

examples.en: She passed the exam despite being nervous.
examples.zh: 儘管很緊張，她還是通過了考試。

examples.en: The storm caused great destruction in the small town.
examples.zh: 暴風雨在小鎮造成嚴重的破壞。

examples.en: The destruction of forests harms many animals.
examples.zh: 森林遭到破壞，傷害了許多動物。

examples.en: Recycling helps reduce the destruction of natural resources.
examples.zh: 回收有助於減少對天然資源的破壞。

examples.en: The detective carefully looked for clues in the library.
examples.zh: 偵探在圖書館裡仔細尋找線索。

examples.en: A famous detective visited our school to talk about his job.
examples.zh: 一位著名的偵探來到我們學校談他的工作。

examples.en: She wants to be a detective when she grows up.
examples.zh: 她長大後想當偵探。

examples.en: Her determination helped her finish the marathon.
examples.zh: 她的決心幫助她跑完了馬拉松。

examples.en: He showed great determination to learn English.
examples.zh: 他展現出學好英文的強烈決心。

examples.en: The determination of the exact cost will take another week.
examples.zh: 確切費用的確定還需要一週。

examples.en: Please turn off all electronic devices during the exam.
examples.zh: 考試期間請關閉所有電子裝置。

examples.en: This small device can measure your heart rate.
examples.zh: 這個小裝置可以測量你的心率。

examples.en: A smoke alarm is a safety device every home should have.
examples.zh: 煙霧警報器是每個家庭都該有的安全設備。

examples.en: The team devised a plan to save energy at school.
examples.zh: 團隊想出了一個在學校節約能源的計畫。

examples.en: She devised a simple game to teach the children numbers.
examples.zh: 她設計了一個簡單的遊戲來教孩子數字。

examples.en: We must devise a better way to share the work.
examples.zh: 我們必須想出更好的分工方式。

examples.en: She decided to devote her weekends to helping at the animal shelter.
examples.zh: 她決定把週末的時間投入動物收容所的志工服務。

examples.en: Many teachers devote years to improving their students' reading skills.
examples.zh: 許多老師花好幾年的時間致力於提升學生的閱讀能力。

examples.en: He devotes an hour every evening to practicing the piano.
examples.zh: 他每天晚上都花一個小時練習鋼琴。

examples.en: Prices differ from store to store, so compare them first.
examples.zh: 每家店的價格都不一樣，所以要先比較。

examples.en: My sister and I differ in our taste in music.
examples.zh: 我和姊姊的音樂品味不同。

examples.en: The two managers differ on how to solve the problem.
examples.zh: 這兩位經理對於如何解決問題的看法不同。

examples.en: Drinking warm water can help you digest food more easily.
examples.zh: 喝溫水可以幫助你更容易消化食物。

examples.en: It took me a while to digest the long report.
examples.zh: 我花了一點時間才消化那份很長的報告。

examples.en: Babies cannot digest some foods until they are older.
examples.zh: 嬰兒要等到大一點才能消化某些食物。

examples.en: The magazine publishes a monthly digest of health news.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌每月刊登一份健康新聞摘要。

examples.en: I read a short digest of the book before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前我讀了這本書的簡短摘要。

examples.en: The weekly digest of school events is posted online.
examples.zh: 每週的校園活動摘要會張貼在網路上。

examples.en: My father bought a new digital camera for our trip.
examples.zh: 我爸爸為了我們的旅行買了一台新的數位相機。

examples.en: The store sells both paper books and digital books.
examples.zh: 這家店同時販售紙本書和電子書。

examples.en: A digital clock on the wall showed the time.
examples.zh: 牆上的數位時鐘顯示著時間。

examples.en: Every person should be treated with dignity and respect.
examples.zh: 對待每個人時，都應維護其尊嚴並給予尊重。

examples.en: She walked out of the room with great dignity.
examples.zh: 她十分莊重地走出了房間。

examples.en: Losing the contest did not hurt his dignity.
examples.zh: 輸掉比賽並沒有傷到他的自尊。

examples.en: Her diligence helped her finish the project early.
examples.zh: 她的勤奮讓她提早完成了專案。

examples.en: The teacher praised the students for their diligence.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚學生們的勤勉。

examples.en: Success often comes from diligence rather than luck.
examples.zh: 成功往往來自勤奮而不是運氣。

examples.en: He received his high school diploma last June.
examples.zh: 他去年六月拿到了高中畢業證書。

examples.en: You need a diploma to apply for this job.
examples.zh: 你需要有文憑才能應徵這份工作。

examples.en: She hung her diploma on the wall of her office.
examples.zh: 她把畢業證書掛在辦公室的牆上。

examples.en: One disadvantage of this phone is its short battery life.
examples.zh: 這支手機的一個缺點是電池續航力很短。

examples.en: Not speaking English can be a big disadvantage when you travel.
examples.zh: 旅行時不會說英文可能是很大的劣勢。

examples.en: The team was at a disadvantage against opponents with taller players.
examples.zh: 對手的球員較高，使這支隊伍處於劣勢。

examples.en: I don't want to disappoint my parents.
examples.zh: 我不想讓我的父母失望。

examples.en: The long wait for the show may disappoint some fans.
examples.zh: 等待表演的時間太長，可能會讓一些粉絲失望。

examples.en: The movie did not disappoint us at all.
examples.zh: 這部電影一點都沒有讓我們失望。

examples.en: The typhoon was a disaster for the farmers in the area.
examples.zh: 這場颱風對當地的農民來說是一場災難。

examples.en: The school holds a drill to prepare students for a disaster.
examples.zh: 學校舉辦演練，讓學生為災害做好準備。

examples.en: Our first cooking class was a complete disaster.
examples.zh: 我們的第一堂烹飪課簡直是一場慘敗。

examples.en: The coach demands strict discipline from the team.
examples.zh: 教練要求球隊遵守嚴格的紀律。

examples.en: It takes discipline to wake up early every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早起需要自律。

examples.en: Biology is a discipline that studies living things.
examples.zh: 生物學是研究生物的一門學科。

examples.en: Parents should discipline their children with patience.
examples.zh: 父母應該有耐心地管教孩子。

examples.en: The company will discipline workers who break the safety rules.
examples.zh: 公司會懲處違反安全規定的員工。

examples.en: She tries to discipline herself to save money each month.
examples.zh: 她努力訓練自己每個月存錢。

examples.en: Don't let one bad grade discourage you from studying.
examples.zh: 不要讓一次成績不好使你對讀書感到氣餒。

examples.en: High prices discourage many people from buying new cars.
examples.zh: 高昂的價格使許多人不願購買新車。

examples.en: The teacher discouraged students from using their phones in class.
examples.zh: 老師勸阻學生在課堂上使用手機。

examples.en: He wore a wig to disguise himself at the costume party.
examples.zh: 他在變裝派對上戴假髮來偽裝自己。

examples.en: She tried to disguise her disappointment with a smile.
examples.zh: 她試著用微笑掩飾自己的失望。

examples.en: The cook disguised the vegetables in the soup so the kids would eat them.
examples.zh: 廚師把蔬菜藏在湯裡，讓孩子們願意吃。

examples.en: The actor wore a clever disguise in the play.
examples.zh: 這位演員在劇中作了巧妙的喬裝。

examples.en: A pair of glasses was his only disguise.
examples.zh: 一副眼鏡是他唯一的偽裝。

examples.en: The costume shop sells masks and other disguises.
examples.zh: 這家服裝店販售面具和其他偽裝道具。

examples.en: She looked at the dirty kitchen with disgust.
examples.zh: 她厭惡地看著髒亂的廚房。

examples.en: The smell of the old fish filled me with disgust.
examples.zh: 那股腐壞魚肉的味道讓我覺得噁心。

examples.en: He showed his disgust by leaving the room.
examples.zh: 他離開房間來表達自己的厭惡。

examples.en: The messy bathroom disgusted the guests who had just arrived.
examples.zh: 凌亂的浴室讓剛抵達的客人們感到厭惡。

examples.en: It disgusts me when people throw trash on the street.
examples.zh: 人們在路上亂丟垃圾讓我覺得很噁心。

examples.en: The smell of the rotten eggs disgusted everyone in the class.
examples.zh: 臭掉的蛋的味道讓全班的人都覺得噁心。

examples.en: The teacher dismissed the class at noon.
examples.zh: 老師在中午讓全班下課。

examples.en: The company dismissed him for being late too often.
examples.zh: 公司因為他太常遲到而把他解僱了。

examples.en: Please don't dismiss her idea before you hear it.
examples.zh: 在聽完之前，請不要把她的想法置之不理。

examples.en: Her desk was in complete disorder after the exam week.
examples.zh: 考試週過後，她的書桌一片混亂。

examples.en: Sleep disorders can make it hard to focus during lessons at school.
examples.zh: 睡眠障礙會讓人很難在學校上課時集中注意力。

examples.en: The doctor explained the causes of the disorder.
examples.zh: 醫生說明了這種疾病的成因。

examples.en: The two neighbors had a dispute over the fence.
examples.zh: 兩位鄰居為了圍籬起了爭執。

examples.en: The labor dispute was finally settled last week.
examples.zh: 這場勞資糾紛終於在上週解決了。

examples.en: There is a dispute about who owns the land.
examples.zh: 關於誰擁有這塊土地還有爭議。

examples.en: My brother and I often dispute who should wash the dishes.
examples.zh: 我哥哥和我常常為了該誰洗碗而爭論。

examples.en: Nobody disputes that exercise is good for your health.
examples.zh: 沒有人否認運動對健康有益。

examples.en: The customer disputed the charge on his bill.
examples.zh: 這位顧客對帳單上的費用提出異議。

examples.en: There is a distinct smell of coffee in the hallway.
examples.zh: 走廊裡有明顯的咖啡香味。

examples.en: Each country has its own distinct culture.
examples.zh: 每個國家都有自己獨特的文化。

examples.en: The two words have distinct meanings in this sentence.
examples.zh: 這兩個字在這個句子裡有不同的意思。

examples.en: It is hard to distinguish the twins from each other.
examples.zh: 很難分辨這對雙胞胎。

examples.en: Children learn to distinguish right from wrong.
examples.zh: 孩子們學著分辨是非對錯。

examples.en: Her bright red coat distinguishes her from the crowd.
examples.zh: 她鮮紅色的外套讓她在人群中顯得與眾不同。

examples.en: The school invited a distinguished writer to give a talk.
examples.zh: 學校邀請了一位傑出的作家來演講。

examples.en: He has had a distinguished career as a doctor.
examples.zh: 他擔任醫生的職涯相當卓越。

examples.en: The professor is a distinguished member of the committee.
examples.zh: 這位教授是委員會中備受敬重的成員。

examples.en: The teacher will distribute the test papers to the students.
examples.zh: 老師會把考卷發給學生。

examples.en: Volunteers distribute free meals to people in need.
examples.zh: 志工們把免費餐點發給有需要的人。

examples.en: The company distributes its products to stores across Taiwan.
examples.zh: 這家公司把產品配送到全台各地的商店。

examples.en: The distribution of free tickets begins at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 免費門票的分發從九點開始。

examples.en: The company has a large distribution network in Asia.
examples.zh: 這家公司在亞洲擁有龐大的配銷網。

examples.en: A fair distribution of work makes the team happier.
examples.zh: 公平分配工作會讓團隊更開心。

examples.en: Our school is in the busiest district of the city.
examples.zh: 我們學校位在市內最熱鬧的地區。

examples.en: This district has many old temples and tea shops.
examples.zh: 這一區有許多古老的廟宇和茶行。

examples.en: Daan District is a popular place for students to live.
examples.zh: 大安區是學生很愛居住的地方。

examples.en: Please don't disturb your brother while he is studying.
examples.zh: 你哥哥在讀書時，請不要打擾他。

examples.en: Loud music from next door disturbed our sleep.
examples.zh: 隔壁傳來的大聲音樂干擾了我們的睡眠。

examples.en: The news about the accident disturbed everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 那起意外的消息讓辦公室裡的每個人都感到不安。

examples.en: People visit the temple to pray for divine help.
examples.zh: 人們到廟裡祈求神明的幫助。

examples.en: The old story is about a divine messenger.
examples.zh: 這個古老的故事是關於一位神聖的使者。

examples.en: The chocolate cake at that café tastes divine.
examples.zh: 那家咖啡店的巧克力蛋糕美味極了。

examples.en: Their divorce was hard on the whole family.
examples.zh: 他們離婚對全家人都是很大的打擊。

examples.en: She said that divorce was the right choice for her.
examples.zh: 她說離婚對她來說是正確的選擇。

examples.en: The number of divorces has risen in recent years.
examples.zh: 近年來離婚的件數增加了。

examples.en: He divorced his wife after ten years of marriage.
examples.zh: 結婚十年後，他和妻子離婚了。

examples.en: My aunt divorced and moved to Taichung.
examples.zh: 我阿姨離婚後搬到了台中。

examples.en: They decided to divorce and remain good friends.
examples.zh: 他們決定離婚，並繼續當好朋友。

senses.zh: 占優勢的；主要的；顯性的

examples.en: Our team was dominant in the second half of the game.
examples.zh: 我們隊在下半場占了上風。

examples.en: English is the dominant language of international business.
examples.zh: 英文是國際商務上的主要語言。

examples.en: In pea plants, purple flowers are a dominant trait.
examples.zh: 在豌豆植株中，紫花是顯性特徵。

senses.zh: 支配；主導；占優勢；在……中占顯著位置

examples.en: Large companies dominate the smartphone market because of their strong brands.
examples.zh: 大公司憑藉強大的品牌優勢主導智慧型手機市場。

examples.en: One loud student tried to dominate the class discussion.
examples.zh: 有一位大聲的學生想要主導課堂討論。

examples.en: The tall tower dominates the view of the city.
examples.zh: 那座高塔在這座城市的景色中格外醒目。

examples.en: I wrote the first draft of my essay on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我星期天寫了作文的初稿。

examples.en: The committee will read the draft of the new rules tomorrow.
examples.zh: 委員會明天會閱讀新規定的草案。

examples.en: A cold draft came in through the open window.
examples.zh: 一陣冷風從打開的窗戶吹進來。

examples.en: She drafted a short letter to her landlord.
examples.zh: 她草擬了一封寫給房東的簡短信件。

examples.en: The manager drafted a plan for the new project.
examples.zh: 經理草擬了新專案的計畫。

examples.en: We drafted the speech together in the library.
examples.zh: 我們一起在圖書館擬定演講稿。

examples.en: Many students dread the day of the final exam.
examples.zh: 許多學生害怕期末考當天的到來。

examples.en: I dread going to the dentist because I dislike the noise.
examples.zh: 我很怕去看牙醫，因為我不喜歡那種噪音。

examples.en: She dreaded telling her parents about the broken window.
examples.zh: 她很擔心要告訴爸媽窗戶破了的事。

examples.en: He felt a dread of speaking in front of the class.
examples.zh: 他對在全班面前說話感到恐懼。

examples.en: Her dread of flying kept her from traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 她對搭飛機的恐懼讓她無法出國旅行。

examples.en: The long wait for the test results filled him with dread.
examples.zh: 等待檢查結果的漫長時間讓他充滿憂慮。

senses.zh: 漂流；飄移；漫無目標地生活

examples.en: The small boat drifted slowly down the river.
examples.zh: 那艘小船沿著河慢慢漂流而下。

examples.en: Snow drifted past the window all afternoon.
examples.zh: 整個下午，雪花都飄過窗外。

examples.en: After graduation, he drifted from job to job.
examples.zh: 畢業後，他一份工作換過一份工作，漫無目標。

examples.en: The drift of the boat took it far from the shore.
examples.zh: 船隻的漂流讓它遠離了海岸。

examples.en: There is a drift toward online shopping among young people.
examples.zh: 年輕人之間有朝網路購物發展的趨勢。

examples.en: A drift of snow blocked the front door.
examples.zh: 一堆積雪擋住了前門。

examples.en: Dad used an electric drill to hang the shelf.
examples.zh: 爸爸用電鑽把架子裝到牆上。

examples.en: Our school holds a fire drill every semester.
examples.zh: 我們學校每學期都會舉辦一次消防演習。

examples.en: The English teacher gave us a grammar drill.
examples.zh: 英文老師給了我們一份文法練習題。

examples.en: The workers drilled a hole in the wall.
examples.zh: 工人在牆上鑽了一個洞。

examples.en: The coach drilled the players on passing.
examples.zh: 教練反覆訓練球員傳球。

examples.en: She drills new vocabulary with flash cards every night.
examples.zh: 她每晚用單字卡反覆練習新單字。

examples.en: The medicine made me feel drowsy in class.
examples.zh: 這個藥讓我在課堂上覺得昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: A warm afternoon can make anyone drowsy.
examples.zh: 溫暖的午後會讓任何人想睡覺。

examples.en: The drowsy driver stopped to rest at the next station.
examples.zh: 昏昏欲睡的司機在下一站停下來休息。

examples.en: This backpack is made of durable cloth.
examples.zh: 這個背包是用耐用的布料製成的。

examples.en: The company sells durable shoes for hiking.
examples.zh: 這家公司販售耐用的登山鞋。

examples.en: A durable friendship can last for many years.
examples.zh: 一段持久的友誼可以延續很多年。

examples.en: The old books on the shelf were dusty.
examples.zh: 架上的舊書積滿了灰塵。

examples.en: We cleaned the dusty attic last weekend.
examples.zh: 我們上週末打掃了灰塵滿布的閣樓。

examples.en: The dusty road led to a small village.
examples.zh: 那條塵土飛揚的路通往一個小村莊。

examples.en: She decided to dye her hair brown.
examples.zh: 她決定把頭髮染成棕色。

examples.en: We dyed the cloth blue in art class.
examples.zh: 我們在美術課把布染成了藍色。

examples.en: My mother dyes eggs for the festival every year.
examples.zh: 我媽媽每年都為了節慶把蛋染色。

examples.en: The dye washed out after a few weeks.
examples.zh: 染劑幾個星期後就褪色了。

examples.en: This store sells natural dye made from plants.
examples.zh: 這家店販售由植物製成的天然染料。

examples.en: He bought a bottle of hair dye at the drugstore.
examples.zh: 他在藥妝店買了一瓶染髮劑。

examples.en: Our new manager is a dynamic young woman.
examples.zh: 我們的新經理是一位充滿活力的年輕女性。

examples.en: Taipei is a dynamic city with many night markets.
examples.zh: 台北是一座充滿活力、有許多夜市的城市。

examples.en: The website shows dynamic maps that update every minute.
examples.zh: 這個網站顯示每分鐘更新的動態地圖。

examples.en: The Tang dynasty is famous for its poetry.
examples.zh: 唐朝以詩詞聞名。

examples.en: We learned about the Ming dynasty in history class.
examples.zh: 我們在歷史課學到了明朝。

examples.en: Three generations of the family built a successful business dynasty.
examples.zh: 這個家族的三代人建立了一個成功的商業世家。

examples.en: He made an earnest effort to learn Japanese.
examples.zh: 他認真努力學習日語。

examples.en: The student gave an earnest apology to the teacher.
examples.zh: 那位學生誠摯地向老師道歉。

examples.en: She is an earnest girl who always does her homework.
examples.zh: 她是個認真的女孩，總是會寫作業。

examples.en: The government announced a new economic plan.
examples.zh: 政府宣布了一項新的經濟計畫。

examples.en: Economic growth has slowed down this year.
examples.zh: 今年的經濟成長趨緩。

examples.en: Many students study economic history in college.
examples.zh: 許多學生在大學修習經濟史。

examples.en: This small car is very economical to drive.
examples.zh: 這台小車開起來非常省錢。

examples.en: We took an economical trip by staying with friends.
examples.zh: 我們這趟旅行住在朋友家，因此相當省錢。

examples.en: Buying in large amounts is often more economical.
examples.zh: 大量購買通常比較划算。

examples.en: My sister studies economics at National Taiwan University.
examples.zh: 我姊姊在台灣大學讀經濟學。

examples.en: Economics explains how people choose what to buy.
examples.zh: 經濟學解釋了人們如何選擇要買什麼。

examples.en: The economics of running a small shop are not easy.
examples.zh: 經營小店涉及的財務問題並不簡單。

examples.en: The economist spoke about rising prices on the news.
examples.zh: 那位經濟學家在新聞上談到物價上漲。

examples.en: An economist from the bank gave a talk at our school.
examples.zh: 銀行的一位經濟學家到我們學校演講。

examples.en: She hopes to become an economist one day.
examples.zh: 她希望有一天能成為經濟學家。

examples.en: The economy grew faster than experts expected.
examples.zh: 經濟成長得比專家預期的還快。

examples.en: Tourism is important to the local economy.
examples.zh: 觀光對當地經濟很重要。

examples.en: For economy, we always buy food in large packs.
examples.zh: 為了節省開銷，我們總是買大包裝的食物。

examples.en: We booked economy seats on the flight to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 我們訂了飛往東京的經濟艙座位。

examples.en: She bought an economy pack of paper towels.
examples.zh: 她買了一大包經濟包裝的紙巾。

examples.en: The airline offers economy fares on weekdays.
examples.zh: 這家航空公司平日提供經濟艙票價。

examples.en: The new software improved the efficiency of our office.
examples.zh: 新軟體提升了我們辦公室的效率。

examples.en: The efficiency of this machine saves a lot of electricity.
examples.zh: 這台機器運作有效率，能節省很多電。

examples.en: Good planning leads to greater efficiency at work.
examples.zh: 好的規劃能帶來更高的工作效率。

examples.en: The skirt has an elastic waistband that makes it comfortable to wear.
examples.zh: 這條裙子的鬆緊腰帶讓它穿起來很舒適。

examples.en: Rubber is an elastic material that can stretch.
examples.zh: 橡膠是一種可以拉長的有彈性的材料。

examples.en: An elastic schedule lets workers plan their own days.
examples.zh: 有彈性的時程表讓員工能自行安排每天的行程。

examples.en: She tied her hair back with a piece of elastic.
examples.zh: 她用一條橡皮筋把頭髮綁起來。

examples.en: The elastic in my old socks has worn out.
examples.zh: 我舊襪子的鬆緊帶已經鬆掉了。

examples.en: Mom sewed new elastic into the pants.
examples.zh: 媽媽把新的鬆緊帶縫進了褲子裡。

examples.en: The store sells phones, cameras, and other electronics.
examples.zh: 這家店販售手機、相機和其他電子產品。

examples.en: My brother wants to study electronics at university.
examples.zh: 我弟弟想在大學學電子學。

examples.en: Please keep electronics away from water to avoid damaging them.
examples.zh: 請讓電子產品遠離水，以免損壞。

senses.zh: 優雅的；高雅的；簡潔漂亮的

examples.en: She wore an elegant black dress to the concert.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件優雅的黑色洋裝去聽音樂會。

examples.en: The hotel has an elegant dining room.
examples.zh: 這家飯店有一間高雅的餐廳。

examples.en: The teacher showed us an elegant solution to the math problem.
examples.zh: 老師向我們展示了這道數學題簡潔漂亮的解法。

examples.en: My little brother goes to elementary school.
examples.zh: 我弟弟讀國小。

examples.en: We started with elementary math lessons before moving on to harder topics.
examples.zh: 我們先上基礎數學課，再進一步學習較難的主題。

examples.en: The class teaches elementary skills for using a computer.
examples.zh: 這堂課教授使用電腦的基本技能。

examples.en: The new program aims to eliminate waste in the cafeteria.
examples.zh: 這項新計畫的目標是消除餐廳的浪費。

examples.en: Our team was eliminated in the second round.
examples.zh: 我們隊在第二輪被淘汰了。

examples.en: The doctor asked him to eliminate sugar from his diet.
examples.zh: 醫生要他在飲食中排除糖分。

examples.en: If you can't find the book here, try looking elsewhere.
examples.zh: 如果你在這裡找不到那本書，可以去別的地方找找。

examples.en: The store is full, so we should go elsewhere for lunch.
examples.zh: 這家店客滿了，所以我們應該去別的地方吃午餐。

examples.en: Prices are lower elsewhere in the city.
examples.zh: 城裡其他地方的價格比較低。

examples.en: The embassy is open from nine to five on weekdays.
examples.zh: 大使館平日從九點開放到五點。

examples.en: She went to the embassy to renew her passport.
examples.zh: 她去大使館換發護照。

examples.en: The embassy sent a message to all citizens living abroad.
examples.zh: 大使館傳了一則訊息給所有住在國外的國民。

examples.en: A small rabbit emerged from behind the bush.
examples.zh: 一隻小兔子從灌木叢後面跑了出來。

examples.en: The sun finally emerged after three days of rain.
examples.zh: 連下三天雨之後，太陽終於露臉了。

examples.en: New problems often emerge when a project becomes larger.
examples.zh: 專案規模變大時，常常會出現新的問題。

examples.en: Our school puts great emphasis on reading.
examples.zh: 我們學校非常重視閱讀。

examples.en: The teacher placed special emphasis on the last chapter.
examples.zh: 老師特別強調最後一章。

examples.en: In this word, the emphasis falls on the first syllable.
examples.zh: 這個字的重音落在第一個音節。

examples.en: The Roman Empire once controlled much of Europe.
examples.zh: 羅馬帝國曾經控制歐洲的大部分地區。

examples.en: The emperor ruled a large empire for forty years.
examples.zh: 那位皇帝統治一個大帝國長達四十年。

examples.en: He built a food empire from one small restaurant.
examples.zh: 他從一間小餐廳起家，建立了餐飲王國。

examples.en: Please enclose a copy of your résumé with the application.
examples.zh: 請隨申請文件附上一份你的履歷副本。

examples.en: A tall fence encloses the school playground.
examples.zh: 一道高高的圍籬圍住學校的操場。

examples.en: She enclosed a photo in the letter to her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她在寫給奶奶的信裡附了一張照片。

examples.en: We encountered heavy traffic on the way to the airport.
examples.zh: 我們前往機場的路上遇到嚴重塞車。

examples.en: Travelers may encounter language problems in a foreign country.
examples.zh: 旅客在國外可能會遇到語言上的問題。

examples.en: She encountered an old friend at the night market.
examples.zh: 她在夜市巧遇一位老朋友。

examples.en: My first encounter with snow was in Japan.
examples.zh: 我第一次見到雪是在日本。

examples.en: The two teams had an encounter in the final match.
examples.zh: 這兩支隊伍在決賽中碰頭。

examples.en: It was a brief encounter, but I remember it well.
examples.zh: 那只是一次短暫的相遇，但我記得很清楚。

examples.en: Littering can endanger the animals living in the river.
examples.zh: 亂丟垃圾可能危害住在河裡的動物。

examples.en: Driving too fast will endanger you and other drivers.
examples.zh: 開太快會讓你和其他駕駛人陷入危險。

examples.en: Pollution endangers the health of people in big cities.
examples.zh: 污染危害大城市居民的健康。

examples.en: The runners endured the hot weather during the race.
examples.zh: 跑者們在比賽中忍受著炎熱的天氣。

examples.en: I can't endure this noise any longer.
examples.zh: 我再也無法忍受這個噪音了。

examples.en: Their friendship has endured for more than twenty years.
examples.zh: 他們的友誼已經持續超過二十年。

examples.en: The police enforce the traffic laws in this area.
examples.zh: 警方在這一帶執行交通法規。

examples.en: Our school enforces a strict rule about wearing uniforms.
examples.zh: 我們學校嚴格執行穿制服的規定。

examples.en: It is hard to enforce a rule that nobody understands.
examples.zh: 沒有人了解的規定很難強制執行。

examples.en: She studied engineering at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她在台北的一所大學念工程。

examples.en: Bridge engineering requires careful math and planning.
examples.zh: 橋梁工程需要仔細的計算與規劃。

examples.en: The company hired a new engineering team last month.
examples.zh: 這家公司上個月聘請了一個新的工程團隊。

examples.en: Can you enlarge this photo so we can print it?
examples.zh: 你可以把這張照片放大，讓我們列印嗎？

examples.en: The city plans to enlarge the old train station.
examples.zh: 市政府打算擴建那座老火車站。

examples.en: Click here to enlarge the map on your screen.
examples.zh: 點選這裡可以放大螢幕上的地圖。

examples.en: An enormous tree stands in front of our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校前面有一棵巨大的樹。

examples.en: The concert attracted an enormous crowd of young people.
examples.zh: 這場演唱會吸引了大批年輕人。

examples.en: Moving to a new city was an enormous change for her.
examples.zh: 搬到新城市對她來說是很大的改變。

examples.en: Please ensure that all the windows are closed before you leave.
examples.zh: 離開前請確認所有窗戶都已關好。

examples.en: The teacher checked the list to ensure nobody was missing.
examples.zh: 老師核對名單，確保沒有人漏掉。

examples.en: Regular exercise helps ensure good health by keeping the body active.
examples.zh: 規律運動讓身體保持活躍，有助於維持健康。

examples.en: The clown entertained the children with funny tricks.
examples.zh: 小丑用有趣的把戲逗孩子們開心。

examples.en: We entertained our relatives at home during the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期期間我們在家招待親戚。

examples.en: This game is designed to entertain young kids.
examples.zh: 這款遊戲是為了讓小朋友玩得開心而設計的。

examples.en: The students showed great enthusiasm for the science project.
examples.zh: 學生們對這個科學專案展現出極大的熱忱。

examples.en: She spoke about her trip with enthusiasm.
examples.zh: 她熱情洋溢地談著她的旅行。

examples.en: His enthusiasm for music made everyone smile.
examples.zh: 他對音樂的熱情讓大家都笑了。

examples.en: Every child should have equality of opportunity in education.
examples.zh: 每個孩子都應享有平等的受教育機會。

examples.en: The speech was about equality between men and women.
examples.zh: 這場演說的主題是男女平等。

examples.en: Our class discussed the importance of equality at work.
examples.zh: 我們班討論了工作場合中平等的重要性。

examples.en: The new classroom is equipped with a large screen.
examples.zh: 新教室配備了一個大螢幕。

examples.en: Parents should equip their children with basic safety knowledge.
examples.zh: 父母應該讓孩子具備基本的安全知識。

examples.en: We need to equip the kitchen before the restaurant opens.
examples.zh: 餐廳開幕前，我們得把廚房設備備齊。

examples.en: We live in the era of smartphones.
examples.zh: 我們活在智慧型手機的時代。

examples.en: My grandfather often talks about the era of black-and-white TV.
examples.zh: 我爺爺常常提起黑白電視的年代。

examples.en: The invention of the Internet began a new era.
examples.zh: 網際網路的發明開啟了一個新時代。

examples.en: Water is essential for all living things.
examples.zh: 水對所有生物都不可或缺。

examples.en: A passport is essential when you travel abroad.
examples.zh: 出國旅行時護照是必備的。

examples.en: Good communication is essential in any team.
examples.zh: 良好的溝通在任何團隊中都是必要的。

examples.en: Pack the essentials, such as clothes and a toothbrush.
examples.zh: 把衣服和牙刷之類的必需品帶好。

examples.en: The guide covers the essentials of English grammar.
examples.zh: 這本指南涵蓋英文文法的基本要點。

examples.en: Food and water are the essentials for a hiking trip.
examples.zh: 食物和水是健行旅程中的必需品。

examples.en: The company was established in 1990 to produce bicycle parts.
examples.zh: 這家公司創立於一九九〇年，生產自行車零件。

examples.en: They want to establish a new rule for the club.
examples.zh: 他們想為社團訂定一條新規則。

examples.en: It takes time to establish trust between friends.
examples.zh: 朋友之間建立信任需要時間。

examples.en: Experts estimate that the trip will take three hours.
examples.zh: 專家估計這趟旅程要三小時。

examples.en: Can you estimate how much the repairs will cost?
examples.zh: 你能估算修理要花多少錢嗎？

examples.en: We estimated the height of the tree to be ten meters.
examples.zh: 我們估計這棵樹高約十公尺。

examples.en: The mechanic gave us an estimate for the repair.
examples.zh: 技師給了我們一份維修報價。

examples.en: My estimate is that about fifty people will come.
examples.zh: 我的估計是大約會有五十人來。

examples.en: According to one estimate, the town has ten thousand people.
examples.zh: 根據一項估計，這個小鎮約有一萬人。

examples.en: The teacher will evaluate each student's final project.
examples.zh: 老師會評量每位學生的期末專案。

examples.en: We need to evaluate the cost before buying a car.
examples.zh: 買車之前我們得先評估費用。

examples.en: The company evaluates its workers once a year.
examples.zh: 公司每年評核員工一次。

examples.en: The team's eventual win surprised everyone after a poor start.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍開局不佳，最終卻獲勝，令所有人都很驚訝。

examples.en: Her eventual goal is to become a doctor.
examples.zh: 她的最終目標是成為醫生。

examples.en: The eventual cost of the project was much higher than planned.
examples.zh: 這項專案最終的成本比原先計畫的高出許多。

examples.en: There is no evidence that the story is true.
examples.zh: 沒有證據顯示這個故事是真的。

examples.en: The scientist collected evidence from many places.
examples.zh: 科學家從許多地方蒐集證據。

examples.en: The wet floor was evidence that someone had just cleaned it.
examples.zh: 濕濕的地板顯示剛有人打掃過。

examples.en: It was evident that she had worked hard on the report.
examples.zh: 很明顯她在這份報告上下了很多功夫。

examples.en: His joy was evident from the big smile on his face.
examples.zh: 從他臉上的大大笑容可以明顯看出他的喜悅。

examples.en: The need for more teachers is evident to everyone.
examples.zh: 每個人都看得出需要更多老師。

examples.en: Don't exaggerate; the movie wasn't that bad.
examples.zh: 別誇張了，那部電影沒那麼糟。

examples.en: He likes to exaggerate when he tells stories about his trips.
examples.zh: 他講旅行的故事時總愛誇大其詞。

examples.en: The ad exaggerates the benefits of the product.
examples.zh: 這則廣告誇大了產品的好處。

examples.en: Everyone in our class passed the final test without exception.
examples.zh: 我們班所有人無一例外都通過了期末測驗。

examples.en: Most students wear uniforms, but Tom is an exception.
examples.zh: 大部分學生都穿制服，但湯姆是個例外。

examples.en: The store is open every day with the exception of Monday.
examples.zh: 這家店除了星期一以外天天營業。

examples.en: The long hike exhausted all of us.
examples.zh: 這趟長途健行讓我們全都筋疲力盡。

examples.en: We may exhaust our supply of water if we stay longer.
examples.zh: 如果待久一點，我們的水可能會用完。

examples.en: Taking care of three children can exhaust anyone.
examples.zh: 照顧三個孩子會讓任何人累壞。

examples.en: The exhaust from the bus made the air smell bad.
examples.zh: 公車排出的廢氣讓空氣聞起來很糟。

examples.en: A broken exhaust pipe can be dangerous.
examples.zh: 破損的排氣管可能很危險。

examples.en: The mechanic checked the exhaust of the old car.
examples.zh: 技師檢查了那輛舊車的排氣系統。

examples.en: The museum will exhibit paintings from local artists.
examples.zh: 博物館將展出當地藝術家的畫作。

examples.en: Students exhibited their science projects in the hall.
examples.zh: 學生們在大廳展示他們的科學專案。

examples.en: Some dogs exhibit signs of fear during storms.
examples.zh: 有些狗在暴風雨期間會表現出害怕的跡象。

examples.en: The exhibit on dinosaurs is popular with children.
examples.zh: 恐龍展很受小朋友歡迎。

examples.en: We spent an hour at the photo exhibit.
examples.zh: 我們在攝影展待了一個小時。

examples.en: Each exhibit has a short description beside it.
examples.zh: 每件展品旁邊都有簡短的說明。

examples.en: The company plans to expand its business to Asia.
examples.zh: 這家公司打算把業務拓展到亞洲。

examples.en: Water expands when it freezes, which can cause pipes to burst.
examples.zh: 水結冰時會膨脹，可能導致水管破裂。

examples.en: Reading different kinds of books helps expand your vocabulary.
examples.zh: 閱讀不同種類的書籍有助於擴充你的字彙量。

examples.en: The expansion of the airport will take two years.
examples.zh: 機場的擴建工程需要兩年。

examples.en: The company announced an expansion into the Japanese market.
examples.zh: 這家公司宣布將擴展到日本市場。

examples.en: Heat causes the expansion of metal, so the parts need extra space.
examples.zh: 熱會使金屬膨脹，因此零件需要預留額外空間。

examples.en: The school is trying an experimental method of teaching math.
examples.zh: 學校正在嘗試一種實驗性的數學教學法。

examples.en: The experimental bus runs on electricity instead of diesel fuel.
examples.zh: 這輛實驗用公車以電力行駛，而非使用柴油。

examples.en: It is still an experimental program, so changes may happen.
examples.zh: 這仍是實驗性質的計畫，所以可能會有變動。

examples.en: The teacher gave a clear explanation of the new rule.
examples.zh: 老師對新規定做了清楚的說明。

examples.en: She has no explanation for why she was late.
examples.zh: 她對自己為什麼遲到沒有任何解釋。

examples.en: Please read the explanation before you start the test.
examples.zh: 開始測驗之前請先閱讀說明。

examples.en: The explosion was heard from far away.
examples.zh: 很遠的地方都聽得到那聲爆炸。

examples.en: There has been an explosion in the number of online shops.
examples.zh: 網路商店的數量暴增。

examples.en: Workers left the building after the gas explosion.
examples.zh: 瓦斯爆炸後，工人都離開了大樓。

senses.zh: 爆炸性的；易爆的；暴躁的

examples.en: Gas is explosive, so keep it away from fire.
examples.zh: 瓦斯易爆炸，所以要遠離火源。

examples.en: The city has seen explosive growth in online shopping recently.
examples.zh: 這座城市最近的網路購物呈現爆炸性成長。

examples.en: He has an explosive temper when he is tired.
examples.zh: 他累的時候脾氣很暴躁。

examples.en: Workers used explosives to open a tunnel through the mountain.
examples.zh: 工人用炸藥開通穿過山的隧道。

examples.en: Explosives must be stored in a safe place.
examples.zh: 炸藥必須存放在安全的地方。

examples.en: The engineer was trained to handle explosives.
examples.zh: 那位工程師受過處理炸藥的訓練。

examples.en: Don't expose the photos to direct sunlight.
examples.zh: 別讓照片曝曬在陽光直射下。

examples.en: The reporter exposed a serious problem in the company.
examples.zh: 記者揭露了這家公司的一項嚴重問題。

examples.en: Parents should expose their children to different cultures.
examples.zh: 父母應該讓孩子接觸不同的文化。

examples.en: Long exposure to the sun can hurt your skin.
examples.zh: 長時間曬太陽可能傷害皮膚。

examples.en: The actor got a lot of exposure from the TV show.
examples.zh: 那位演員因為這個電視節目獲得很高的曝光度。

examples.en: Early exposure to English helps children learn faster.
examples.zh: 及早接觸英文有助於孩子學得更快。

examples.en: The library decided to extend its opening hours.
examples.zh: 圖書館決定延長開放時間。

examples.en: The road extends all the way to the beach.
examples.zh: 這條路一直延伸到海灘。

examples.en: Can you extend the deadline until Friday?
examples.zh: 你可以把截止日期延到星期五嗎？

examples.en: I agree with you to some extent.
examples.zh: 我在某種程度上同意你。

examples.en: The storm's extent was larger than we expected.
examples.zh: 這場風暴的規模比我們預期的大。

examples.en: No one knew the full extent of the damage.
examples.zh: 沒有人知道損害的全貌。

examples.en: His facial expression showed that he was surprised.
examples.zh: 他的臉部表情顯示他很驚訝。

examples.en: She bought a facial cream at the drugstore.
examples.zh: 她在藥妝店買了一罐臉部保養霜。

examples.en: The doctor checked the facial skin for allergies.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查臉部皮膚有沒有過敏。

examples.en: She booked a facial for Saturday afternoon.
examples.zh: 她預約了星期六下午的臉部護理。

examples.en: A facial can help your skin feel fresh.
examples.zh: 臉部護理可以讓皮膚感覺清爽。

examples.en: My sister gave my mom a facial as a gift.
examples.zh: 我姊姊送我媽媽臉部護理當禮物。

examples.en: The school has a new sports facility.
examples.zh: 學校有一座新的運動設施。

examples.en: The hotel offers facilities for people with disabilities.
examples.zh: 這家飯店提供身心障礙者使用的設施。

examples.en: This research facility is open to the public once a year.
examples.zh: 這處研究設施每年對外開放一次。

examples.en: The dog was faithful to its owner for many years.
examples.zh: 那隻狗多年來對主人忠心耿耿。

examples.en: She is a faithful friend who always keeps her promises.
examples.zh: 她是個忠實的朋友，總是信守承諾。

examples.en: The movie is faithful to the original novel.
examples.zh: 這部電影忠於原著小說。

examples.en: The singer rose to fame at the age of twenty.
examples.zh: 那位歌手二十歲就成名了。

examples.en: Fame did not change the way she treated her fans.
examples.zh: 成名並沒有改變她對待粉絲的方式。

examples.en: The small town gained fame for its traditional tea making.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮因傳統製茶工藝而聞名。

examples.en: She loves reading fantasy novels about dragons and magic.
examples.zh: 她喜歡閱讀有關龍與魔法的奇幻小說。

examples.en: His dream of becoming a king was just a fantasy.
examples.zh: 他想當國王的夢想只是空想。

examples.en: Children often live in a world of fantasy.
examples.zh: 孩子常常活在幻想的世界裡。

examples.en: We held a farewell party for our teacher.
examples.zh: 我們為老師辦了一場歡送會。

examples.en: She waved farewell to her friends at the airport.
examples.zh: 她在機場向朋友揮手道別。

examples.en: The speech was a warm farewell to the team.
examples.zh: 這場演說是對團隊溫馨的告別。

examples.en: Please fasten your seat belt before the bus moves.
examples.zh: 公車開動前請繫好安全帶。

examples.en: He fastened the box with strong tape.
examples.zh: 他用堅固的膠帶把箱子封好。

examples.en: She fastened the sign to the wall.
examples.zh: 她把告示牌固定在牆上。

senses.zh: 致命的；造成嚴重後果的

examples.en: The doctor said the disease was not fatal.
examples.zh: 醫生說這個病不會致命。

examples.en: Using a phone while driving can lead to fatal accidents.
examples.zh: 開車時使用手機可能導致致命的意外。

examples.en: One small mistake had a fatal effect on the plan.
examples.zh: 一個小錯誤對這項計畫造成了毀滅性的影響。

examples.en: The weather was favorable for our picnic.
examples.zh: 天氣很適合我們野餐。

examples.en: The new teacher made a favorable impression on the class.
examples.zh: 新老師給全班留下了良好的印象。

examples.en: Most people gave a favorable answer to the survey.
examples.zh: 大部分的人在問卷中給了正面的回答。

examples.en: Please send me the contract by fax.
examples.zh: 請用傳真把合約寄給我。

examples.en: The office still has an old fax in the corner.
examples.zh: 辦公室角落還放著一台舊的傳真機。

examples.en: I received a fax from the bank this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上收到銀行傳來的傳真。

examples.en: Could you fax this form to the school?
examples.zh: 你可以把這份表格傳真給學校嗎？

examples.en: She faxed the report to her boss right away.
examples.zh: 她立刻把報告傳真給老闆。

examples.en: We faxed the order to the supplier.
examples.zh: 我們把訂單傳真給供應商。

examples.en: The village held a feast to celebrate the harvest.
examples.zh: 村莊舉辦了一場盛宴來慶祝豐收。

examples.en: We prepared a holiday feast for the whole family.
examples.zh: 我們為全家人準備了一桌節慶大餐。

examples.en: The wedding feast lasted until late at night.
examples.zh: 婚宴一直持續到深夜。

examples.en: The guests feasted on roast chicken and fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 賓客們大啖烤雞和新鮮水果。

examples.en: After the game, the team feasted at a local restaurant.
examples.zh: 比賽結束後，球隊在當地一家餐廳大快朵頤。

examples.en: They feasted the visitors with traditional dishes.
examples.zh: 他們用傳統菜餚盛情款待訪客。

examples.en: The teacher gave us helpful feedback on our essays.
examples.zh: 老師對我們的作文給了很有幫助的回饋。

examples.en: We welcome your feedback about our new service.
examples.zh: 我們歡迎您對新服務提出意見。

examples.en: The customer feedback was mostly positive after we improved the service.
examples.zh: 我們改善服務後，顧客的回饋大多是正面的。

examples.en: We took the ferry across the river to the island.
examples.zh: 我們搭渡輪過河到島上。

examples.en: The last ferry leaves the harbor at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 最後一班渡輪九點離開港口。

examples.en: A ferry runs between the two cities every hour.
examples.zh: 兩座城市之間每小時有一班渡輪。

examples.en: Small boats ferry tourists to the nearby island.
examples.zh: 小船把遊客載送到附近的島上。

examples.en: My mother ferries the kids to school every morning.
examples.zh: 我媽媽每天早上接送孩子們上學。

examples.en: The company ferried supplies to the camp by boat.
examples.zh: 公司用船把物資運送到營地。

examples.en: The valley has fertile soil that is good for growing rice.
examples.zh: 這個山谷的土壤肥沃，很適合種稻。

examples.en: Farmers moved to the fertile land near the river.
examples.zh: 農夫搬到河邊肥沃的土地上。

examples.en: A fertile imagination helps writers create new stories.
examples.zh: 豐富的想像力幫助作家創作新故事。

examples.en: Please fetch me a glass of water from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 請從廚房幫我拿一杯水來。

examples.en: The dog ran to fetch the ball.
examples.zh: 小狗跑去把球撿回來。

examples.en: I will fetch the children from school at three.
examples.zh: 我三點會去學校接孩子們。

examples.en: She enjoys reading science fiction in her free time.
examples.zh: 她空閒時喜歡閱讀科幻小說。

examples.en: The library has a large section of fiction for teenagers.
examples.zh: 圖書館有一大區專門給青少年的小說。

examples.en: Everything in this story is pure fiction.
examples.zh: 這個故事裡的一切純屬虛構。

examples.en: The farmer kept a fierce dog to guard the barn.
examples.zh: 農夫養了一隻兇猛的狗來看守穀倉。

examples.en: There was fierce competition for the scholarship.
examples.zh: 這項獎學金的競爭十分激烈。

examples.en: A fierce wind blew across the open field.
examples.zh: 強風吹過空曠的田野。

examples.en: She studied finance at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她在台北的一所大學研讀財務金融。

examples.en: My uncle works in the finance department of a large company.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在一家大公司的財務部門工作。

examples.en: The school needs more finance for its new library.
examples.zh: 學校需要更多資金來興建新圖書館。

examples.en: The government will finance the new bridge.
examples.zh: 政府將出資興建這座新橋。

examples.en: He financed his studies by working part-time.
examples.zh: 他靠打工來支付學費。

examples.en: The project was financed by a local bank.
examples.zh: 這項專案由一家當地銀行提供資金。

examples.en: The family is facing serious financial problems.
examples.zh: 這個家庭正面臨嚴重的財務問題。

examples.en: She asked a financial adviser for help with her savings.
examples.zh: 她請財務顧問幫忙規劃儲蓄。

examples.en: The company released its financial report this morning.
examples.zh: 公司今天早上公布了財務報告。

examples.en: We sat by the fireplace and drank hot chocolate.
examples.zh: 我們坐在壁爐旁喝熱可可。

examples.en: The old house has a large stone fireplace in the living room.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子的客廳有一座大石砌壁爐。

examples.en: Dad put another log in the fireplace.
examples.zh: 爸爸又往壁爐裡放了一根木柴。

senses.zh: 奉承；使受寵若驚；使顯得好看

examples.en: He tried to flatter his boss to get a promotion.
examples.zh: 他試圖奉承老闆以求升遷。

examples.en: I was flattered when she asked for my advice.
examples.zh: 她來徵求我的意見，讓我受寵若驚。

examples.en: That blue dress flatters her figure without being too tight.
examples.zh: 那件藍色洋裝不會太緊，又能襯托她的身形。

examples.en: Our dog scratched all day because of a flea.
examples.zh: 我們的狗因為跳蚤而整天抓癢。

examples.en: The vet gave us a medicine to kill fleas.
examples.zh: 獸醫給了我們殺跳蚤的藥。

examples.en: A flea can jump much higher than its own body.
examples.zh: 跳蚤能跳得比自己的身體高很多。

examples.en: Many families had to flee the area before the typhoon arrived.
examples.zh: 颱風來襲前，許多家庭必須撤離這個地區。

examples.en: The cat fled when it heard the loud noise.
examples.zh: 貓聽到巨大聲響就逃走了。

examples.en: He fled the country to look for a better life.
examples.zh: 他逃離那個國家，去尋找更好的生活。

senses.zh: 有彈性的；靈活的；可變通的

examples.en: This plastic ruler is thin and flexible.
examples.zh: 這把塑膠尺又薄又有彈性。

examples.en: My boss lets me have flexible working hours.
examples.zh: 我的老闆讓我有彈性的上班時間。

examples.en: We need a flexible plan in case it rains.
examples.zh: 我們需要一個靈活的計畫以防下雨。

examples.en: She is fluent in both English and Japanese.
examples.zh: 她的英文和日文都很流利。

examples.en: His fluent speech impressed the judges at the English competition.
examples.zh: 他在英文比賽中流暢的演講讓評審印象深刻。

examples.en: It takes years of practice to become fluent in a language.
examples.zh: 要把一種語言說得流利需要多年練習。

examples.en: Please flush the toilet after you use it.
examples.zh: 使用完馬桶後請沖水。

examples.en: Her face flushed with embarrassment when she forgot her lines.
examples.zh: 她忘記台詞時，窘得滿臉通紅。

examples.en: He flushed the pipes with clean water.
examples.zh: 他用清水沖洗水管。

examples.en: Press the button to start the flush.
examples.zh: 按下按鈕開始沖水。

examples.en: A flush of pink appeared on her cheeks.
examples.zh: 她的臉頰泛起一片粉紅。

examples.en: The flush of the toilet was too loud.
examples.zh: 馬桶的沖水聲太大了。

examples.en: The waves left white foam on the sand.
examples.zh: 海浪在沙灘上留下白色泡沫。

examples.en: She added milk foam to her coffee.
examples.zh: 她在咖啡裡加了奶泡。

examples.en: The mattress is made of soft foam.
examples.zh: 這張床墊是用柔軟的泡綿做的。

examples.en: The soap began to foam in the water.
examples.zh: 肥皂在水裡開始起泡。

examples.en: The sea foamed around the rocks as the waves crashed against them.
examples.zh: 海浪拍打岩石時，海水在岩石周圍翻起泡沫。

examples.en: Shake the bottle and the drink will foam.
examples.zh: 搖一搖瓶子，飲料就會起泡。

examples.en: My parents forbid me to stay out after ten.
examples.zh: 我爸媽不准我在外面待到十點以後。

examples.en: School rules forbid students from using phones in class.
examples.zh: 校規禁止學生在課堂上使用手機。

examples.en: The sign forbids entry to visitors without an appointment.
examples.zh: 這塊告示牌禁止未預約的訪客進入。

examples.en: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
examples.zh: 天氣預報說明天會下雨。

examples.en: The company released its sales forecast for next year.
examples.zh: 公司公布了明年的銷售預測。

examples.en: According to the forecast, temperatures will drop this weekend.
examples.zh: 根據預報，這個週末氣溫會下降。

examples.en: Experts forecast a strong typhoon next week.
examples.zh: 專家預測下週會有強烈颱風。

examples.en: The bank forecasts that prices will rise slowly.
examples.zh: 銀行預測物價會緩慢上漲。

examples.en: Nobody could forecast the result of the election.
examples.zh: 沒有人能預測選舉的結果。

examples.en: The formation of ice takes place below zero degrees.
examples.zh: 冰的形成發生在零度以下。

examples.en: The birds flew south in a V formation.
examples.zh: 鳥群以 V 字隊形向南飛。

examples.en: The rock formation attracts many tourists every year.
examples.zh: 這個岩層景觀每年吸引許多遊客。

examples.en: Students must memorize this math formula for the exam.
examples.zh: 學生必須為了考試背熟這個數學公式。

examples.en: The baby drinks milk formula three times a day.
examples.zh: 寶寶一天喝三次配方奶。

examples.en: There is no easy formula for success.
examples.zh: 成功沒有簡單的公式。

examples.en: The old fort stands on a hill above the town.
examples.zh: 古老的要塞矗立在小鎮上方的山丘上。

examples.en: Tourists can walk around the fort and enjoy the sea view.
examples.zh: 遊客可以在要塞周圍散步，欣賞海景。

examples.en: The children built a fort out of pillows.
examples.zh: 孩子們用枕頭蓋了一座堡壘。

examples.en: We were fortunate to find a seat on the train.
examples.zh: 我們很幸運在火車上找到座位。

examples.en: She is fortunate to have such kind neighbors.
examples.zh: 她很幸運有這麼友善的鄰居。

examples.en: It was fortunate that nobody was hurt in the accident.
examples.zh: 幸好沒有人在這場意外中受傷。

examples.en: The house has a strong foundation of concrete.
examples.zh: 這棟房子有穩固的混凝土地基。

examples.en: Good habits are the foundation of success.
examples.zh: 好習慣是成功的基礎。

examples.en: The foundation gives money to poor students.
examples.zh: 這個基金會提供經費給清寒學生。

examples.en: The founder of the company started it in a small garage.
examples.zh: 這家公司的創辦人是在一間小車庫裡起步的。

examples.en: The school honors its founder every year.
examples.zh: 學校每年都會紀念它的創辦人。

examples.en: She is the founder of a local charity.
examples.zh: 她是一個當地慈善團體的創辦人。

examples.en: She put the photo in a wooden frame.
examples.zh: 她把照片放進木框裡。

examples.en: The bike has a light aluminum frame.
examples.zh: 這輛腳踏車有輕巧的鋁製車架。

examples.en: He wears glasses with thin black frames.
examples.zh: 他戴著黑色細框眼鏡。

examples.en: We framed the picture and hung it on the wall.
examples.zh: 我們把畫裱框後掛在牆上。

examples.en: The teacher framed the question in a simple way.
examples.zh: 老師用簡單的方式陳述這個問題。

examples.en: Tall trees frame the view of the lake.
examples.zh: 高大的樹木為湖景構成了畫框。

examples.en: The company increased bus frequency to six departures an hour.
examples.zh: 公司把公車班次增加為每小時六班。

examples.en: Doctors measured the frequency of her heartbeat.
examples.zh: 醫生測量了她的心跳頻率。

examples.en: The radio station broadcasts on a different frequency at night.
examples.zh: 這個廣播電台晚上使用不同的頻率播送。

examples.en: My sister is a freshman at National Taiwan University.
examples.zh: 我姊姊是台灣大學的大一新生。

examples.en: The freshmen met their classmates at the orientation.
examples.zh: 新生們在迎新活動中認識了同學。

examples.en: As a freshman, he joined the school's basketball team.
examples.zh: 身為新生，他加入了學校的籃球隊。

examples.en: There was frost on the grass this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上草地上結了霜。

examples.en: The frost killed some of the plants in the garden.
examples.zh: 霜凍讓花園裡的一些植物枯死了。

examples.en: Dad scraped the frost off the car window.
examples.zh: 爸爸刮掉車窗上的霜。

examples.en: The teacher frowned when she saw the messy desk.
examples.zh: 老師看到凌亂的書桌時皺起了眉頭。

examples.en: Don't frown; the problem is easy to solve.
examples.zh: 別皺眉頭，這個問題很容易解決。

examples.en: Many people frown on loud talking in the library.
examples.zh: 許多人不贊同在圖書館大聲說話。

examples.en: He answered the question with a frown.

examples.zh: 網路很慢會讓所有在家工作的人感到沮喪。

examples.zh: 這道很難的數學題讓全班都很挫折。

examples.zh: 節慶特賣期間，大排長龍讓許多顧客感到不耐煩。

examples.zh: 她努力工作，想實現成為醫生的夢想。

examples.zh: 公司必須履行對顧客的承諾。

examples.zh: 這個房間能滿足一個小家庭的所有需求。

examples.zh: 這間廚房雖小卻非常實用。

examples.zh: 這支新手機有許多實用的功能。

examples.en: The old machine is still fully functional.
examples.zh: 這台舊機器仍然完全可以運作。

examples.en: Reading is a fundamental skill for every student.
examples.zh: 閱讀是每個學生的基本能力。

examples.en: There is a fundamental difference between the two plans.
examples.zh: 這兩個計畫有根本上的差異。

examples.en: Clean water is a fundamental need for all people.
examples.zh: 乾淨的水是所有人的基本需求。

examples.zh: 這門課教授烹飪的基本原則。

examples.en: You should learn the fundamentals before trying advanced skills.
examples.zh: 在嘗試進階技巧之前，你應該先學好基礎。

examples.zh: 他向孩子們說明這個遊戲的基本規則。

examples.en: Many relatives attended the funeral last Saturday.
examples.zh: 許多親戚參加了上週六的葬禮。

examples.en: He wore a black suit to the funeral.
examples.zh: 他穿著黑色西裝去參加葬禮。

examples.en: The family held a quiet funeral for their grandfather.
examples.zh: 家人為爺爺舉行了一場簡單安靜的喪禮。

examples.en: Dad was furious when he saw the broken window.
examples.zh: 爸爸看到破掉的窗戶時非常生氣。

examples.en: She sent a furious email to the store manager.
examples.zh: 她寄了一封憤怒的電子郵件給店長。

examples.zh: 昨晚一場猛烈的暴風雨襲擊了海岸。

examples.zh: 他們為公寓配置了沙發和一張小桌子。

examples.zh: 這間旅館客房以現代風格布置家具。

examples.zh: 學校會提供這門課所需的所有書籍。

examples.en: The hotel is cheap; furthermore, it is close to the station.
examples.zh: 這間旅館很便宜，而且離車站很近。

examples.en: The plan is too expensive. Furthermore, it will take too long.
examples.zh: 這個計畫太貴了，而且會花太多時間。

examples.en: He is kind, and furthermore, he is always on time.
examples.zh: 他很親切，此外還總是很準時。

examples.en: We visited an art gallery on Saturday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們週六下午參觀了一間美術館。

examples.en: Her paintings are on display in a small gallery downtown.
examples.zh: 她的畫作在市區一間小畫廊展出。

examples.en: The gallery was quiet and full of beautiful photographs.
examples.zh: 這間展覽廳很安靜，掛滿了美麗的照片。

examples.en: The children gazed at the stars through a telescope.
examples.zh: 孩子們透過望遠鏡凝視星星。

examples.en: She gazed out of the window during the long lesson.
examples.zh: 在漫長的課堂上，她望著窗外出神。

examples.en: He gazed at the old photo for a long time.
examples.zh: 他盯著那張老照片看了很久。

examples.en: His gaze stayed on the beautiful painting.
examples.zh: 他的目光停留在那幅美麗的畫上。

examples.en: The cat fixed its gaze on the bird.
examples.zh: 貓緊盯著那隻鳥。

examples.en: She turned her gaze toward the sea.
examples.zh: 她把視線轉向大海。

examples.en: Don't forget to pack your camping gear.
examples.zh: 別忘了打包你的露營裝備。

examples.en: She shifted to a lower gear to climb the hill.
examples.zh: 她換到較低的排檔來爬坡。

examples.en: A small gear inside the clock stopped working.
examples.zh: 時鐘裡的一個小齒輪停止運轉了。

examples.en: Eye color is determined by genes that we inherit from our parents.
examples.zh: 眼睛的顏色由我們從父母遺傳的基因決定。

examples.en: Scientists found a gene linked to this disease.
examples.zh: 科學家發現了一個與這種疾病有關的基因。

examples.en: She got her curly hair from her mother's genes.
examples.zh: 她的捲髮是遺傳自媽媽的基因。

examples.en: We thanked our neighbor for her generosity.
examples.zh: 我們感謝鄰居的慷慨。

examples.en: The school was built with the generosity of many donors.
examples.zh: 這所學校是靠許多捐款人的慷慨資助而蓋成的。

examples.en: His generosity made him popular among friends.
examples.zh: 他的大方讓他在朋友之間很受歡迎。

examples.en: This is a genuine leather bag from Italy.
examples.zh: 這是一個來自義大利的真皮包。

examples.en: She showed genuine interest in our project.
examples.zh: 她對我們的專案表現出真正的興趣。

examples.en: His apology sounded genuine, so we forgave him quickly.
examples.zh: 他的道歉聽起來很真誠，所以我們很快就原諒了他。

examples.en: Wash your hands to get rid of germs.
examples.zh: 洗手可以除掉細菌。

examples.en: Germs spread easily in crowded places where people gather closely.
examples.zh: 人們密集聚集的擁擠場所很容易傳播病菌。

examples.en: The idea began as a tiny germ in his mind.
examples.zh: 這個想法最初只是他心中一個小小的萌芽。

examples.en: She is a gifted pianist who started playing at age four.
examples.zh: 她是一位有天分的鋼琴家，四歲就開始彈琴。

examples.en: The school has a special class for gifted students.
examples.zh: 這所學校為資優生開設了特別班級。

examples.en: He is a gifted speaker who can move any crowd.
examples.zh: 他是個有天分的演說家，能打動任何群眾。

examples.en: A gigantic tree stands in the middle of the park.
examples.zh: 公園中央有一棵巨大的樹。

examples.en: The shopping mall is gigantic, so we got lost.
examples.zh: 這間購物中心非常龐大，我們迷路了。

examples.en: The movie was a gigantic success around the world.
examples.zh: 這部電影在全世界獲得了巨大的成功。

examples.en: The girls giggled when the teacher made a funny face.
examples.zh: 老師做鬼臉時，女孩們咯咯地笑了起來。

examples.en: Stop giggling and listen to the instructions.
examples.zh: 別再傻笑了，聽一下說明。

examples.en: The baby giggled every time Dad played peekaboo.
examples.zh: 每次爸爸玩躲貓貓，寶寶都會咯咯笑。

examples.en: A giggle came from the back of the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室後面傳來一陣咯咯的笑聲。

examples.en: She let out a nervous giggle before answering the difficult question.
examples.zh: 她回答那個困難的問題前，發出一聲緊張的輕笑。

examples.en: The story gave us all a good giggle.
examples.zh: 這個故事讓我們全都笑了一陣。

examples.en: Mom put a few slices of ginger in the soup.
examples.zh: 媽媽在湯裡放了幾片薑。

examples.en: Ginger tea helps me feel warm in winter.
examples.zh: 薑茶讓我在冬天覺得暖和。

examples.en: Her hair was a bright shade of ginger in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 她的頭髮在陽光下呈現明亮的紅棕色。

examples.en: I caught a glimpse of the singer as she left the hotel.
examples.zh: 那位歌手離開旅館時，我瞥見了她一眼。

examples.en: The tour gave us a glimpse of local life.
examples.zh: 這趟旅程讓我們對當地生活有了初步的了解。

examples.en: He only got a brief glimpse of the train passing by.
examples.zh: 他只匆匆瞥見火車駛過。

examples.en: She glimpsed her friend in the crowd.
examples.zh: 她在人群中瞥見了朋友。

examples.en: We glimpsed a deer between the trees.
examples.zh: 我們在樹林間瞥見了一隻鹿。

examples.en: He glimpsed the price tag and put the shirt back.
examples.zh: 他瞥了一眼價格標籤，就把襯衫放了回去。

examples.en: There is a large globe on the teacher's desk.
examples.zh: 老師的桌上有一個大地球儀。

examples.en: Our company has offices all around the globe.
examples.zh: 我們公司在全球各地都有辦公室。

examples.en: The glass globe hung from the ceiling above the table.
examples.zh: 那個玻璃球體掛在桌子上方的天花板上。

examples.en: The team had a glorious victory in the final game.
examples.zh: 這支球隊在決賽中取得了光榮的勝利。

examples.en: We enjoyed a glorious sunset from the hotel balcony.
examples.zh: 我們在飯店陽台欣賞了絕美的夕陽。

examples.en: It was a glorious morning, so we went for a walk.
examples.zh: 那是個美好的早晨，所以我們去散步。

examples.en: The store sells goods from many different countries.
examples.zh: 這家商店販售來自許多不同國家的商品。

examples.en: Please check that all the goods arrived safely.
examples.zh: 請確認所有貨物都安全送達。

examples.en: Trucks carry goods from the factory to the market.
examples.zh: 卡車把貨物從工廠運到市場。

examples.en: She wore a long white gown to the wedding.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件白色長禮服去參加婚禮。

examples.en: Every student put on a gown for the ceremony.
examples.zh: 每位學生都穿上袍子參加典禮。

examples.en: The nurse handed me a hospital gown to change into.
examples.zh: 護理師遞給我一件病人袍讓我換上。

examples.en: The dancer moved across the stage with grace.
examples.zh: 那位舞者優雅地走過舞台。

examples.en: He accepted the loss with grace and a smile.
examples.zh: 他帶著風度和微笑接受了落敗。

examples.en: The bank gave us a week of grace to pay.
examples.zh: 銀行給了我們一週的寬限期來付款。

examples.en: A beautiful painting graces the wall of our living room.
examples.zh: 一幅美麗的畫為我們客廳的牆面增添光彩。

examples.en: The singer graced the party with her presence.
examples.zh: 那位歌手蒞臨派對，為派對增光。

examples.en: Flowers graced every table at the dinner.
examples.zh: 晚宴的每張桌子都以鮮花點綴。

examples.en: The swan is a graceful bird that moves smoothly across the lake.
examples.zh: 天鵝是一種優雅的鳥，在湖面上平順地游動。

examples.en: She made a graceful turn on the ice.
examples.zh: 她在冰上做了一個優美的轉身。

examples.en: He gave a graceful reply to the rude question.
examples.zh: 他對那個無禮的問題做了得體的回答。

examples.en: Our host was gracious and made us feel welcome.
examples.zh: 主人很親切，讓我們感到賓至如歸。

examples.en: She was gracious enough to forgive my mistake.
examples.zh: 她寬宏大量，原諒了我的錯誤。

examples.en: Thank you for your gracious invitation to dinner.
examples.zh: 謝謝您誠摯邀請我們共進晚餐。

examples.en: Her parents will attend her graduation in June.
examples.zh: 她的父母六月會出席她的畢業典禮。

examples.en: After graduation, he plans to work abroad.
examples.zh: 畢業後，他打算到國外工作。

examples.en: We took many photos on graduation day.
examples.zh: 我們在畢業那天拍了很多照片。

examples.en: Our teacher explains English grammar very clearly.
examples.zh: 我們的老師把英文文法解釋得很清楚。

examples.en: This essay has some mistakes in grammar and spelling.
examples.zh: 這篇作文在文法和拼字上有一些錯誤。

examples.en: I bought a grammar book to prepare for the test.
examples.zh: 我買了一本文法書來準備考試。

examples.en: I am grateful for your help with my homework.
examples.zh: 我很感激你在功課上給我的協助。

examples.en: The family was grateful to the kind neighbors.
examples.zh: 這家人很感謝那些善良的鄰居。

examples.en: We would be grateful if you could reply soon.
examples.zh: 若您能盡快回覆，我們將不勝感激。

examples.en: She wrote a card to show her gratitude.
examples.zh: 她寫了一張卡片表達感謝之意。

examples.en: He bowed in gratitude to his teachers.
examples.zh: 他向老師們鞠躬致謝。

examples.en: Please accept our deep gratitude for your support.
examples.zh: 請接受我們對您支持的由衷感謝。

examples.en: We placed flowers on my grandfather's grave.
examples.zh: 我們在祖父的墳前獻上了花。

examples.en: The old grave was covered with moss.
examples.zh: 那座老墳長滿了青苔。

examples.en: Many people visit the graves during the festival.
examples.zh: 許多人在節日期間去掃墓。

examples.en: The doctor said the situation was grave.
examples.zh: 醫師說情況很嚴重。

examples.en: The manager made a grave mistake in the report.
examples.zh: 經理在報告中犯了嚴重的錯誤。

examples.en: He wore a grave expression when he came in.
examples.zh: 他進來時神情嚴肅。

examples.en: I do not like greasy food in the morning.
examples.zh: 我早上不喜歡吃油膩的食物。

examples.en: His hands were greasy after fixing the bike.
examples.zh: 他修完腳踏車後，雙手沾滿了油汙。

examples.en: Wipe the greasy pan with a paper towel.
examples.zh: 用紙巾把油膩的平底鍋擦一擦。

examples.en: She gave me a warm greeting at the door.
examples.zh: 她在門口熱情地向我打招呼。

examples.zh: 一句友善的問候就能讓人心情愉快。

examples.zh: 我們向所有客戶寄出了節日賀詞。

examples.zh: 她失去寵物後感到非常悲痛。

examples.en: The whole town shared the family's grief.
examples.zh: 全鎮的人都分擔這家人的哀傷。

examples.en: Time helped him get over his grief.
examples.zh: 時間幫助他走出了悲傷。

examples.en: Please grind the coffee beans before making coffee.
examples.zh: 請在煮咖啡前先把咖啡豆磨碎。

examples.en: He ground the pepper over his salad.
examples.zh: 他把胡椒磨到沙拉上。

examples.en: The machine can grind rice into fine powder.
examples.zh: 這部機器可以把米磨成細粉。

senses.zh: 苦差事；單調辛勞的工作

examples.en: The grind of office work made him tired.
examples.zh: 辦公室的單調苦差事讓他很疲倦。

examples.en: Studying for exams can be a real grind.
examples.zh: 準備考試有時真是件苦差事。

examples.en: She was ready for the grind of a new school year.
examples.zh: 她已準備好面對新學年的辛勞。

examples.en: The phone comes with a one-year guarantee.
examples.zh: 這支手機有一年的保固。

examples.en: There is no guarantee that it will stop raining.
examples.zh: 沒有人能保證雨會停。

examples.en: The store offers a money-back guarantee if the product is faulty.
examples.zh: 如果產品有瑕疵，這家商店提供退費保證。

examples.en: We guarantee delivery within three days after receiving your payment.
examples.zh: 收到您的款項後，我們保證三天內送達。

examples.en: Hard work does not guarantee success, but it improves your chances.
examples.zh: 努力並不保證成功，但能提高成功的機會。

examples.en: The company guarantees the quality of its products.
examples.zh: 這家公司保證其產品的品質。

examples.zh: 校外教學的表格必須由監護人簽名。

examples.en: The old man became the child's legal guardian.
examples.zh: 那位老先生成為這個孩子的法定監護人。

examples.en: Rangers act as guardians of the national park.
examples.zh: 護管員是國家公園的守護者。

examples.zh: 他因為忘記她的生日而感到愧疚。

examples.en: The court could not prove his guilt.
examples.zh: 法院無法證明他有罪。

examples.zh: 她多年來一直背負著沉重的罪惡感。

examples.zh: 我對打破朋友的杯子感到內疚。

examples.zh: 法官認定他有罪。

examples.zh: 她臉上露出心虛的表情。

examples.zh: 那艘船在黎明時橫渡海灣。

examples.zh: 貧富之間有很大的鴻溝。

examples.en: A gulf of opinion separated the two teams.
examples.zh: 兩個團隊的意見有很大的差距。

examples.en: He is a habitual late sleeper on weekends.
examples.zh: 他週末習慣性地晚起。

examples.en: Her habitual smile made everyone feel relaxed.
examples.zh: 她一貫的笑容讓大家都感到輕鬆。

examples.zh: 習慣性遲到可能讓同事不高興，並耽誤整個團隊。

examples.en: The bus halted at the red light.
examples.zh: 公車在紅燈前停了下來。

examples.en: The storm halted all train service between the two cities.
examples.zh: 暴風雨使兩座城市之間的所有火車停駛。

examples.en: Please halt the video so I can take notes.
examples.zh: 請暫停影片，讓我記筆記。

examples.zh: 那輛車在學校外面停了下來。

examples.en: The strike brought work to a halt.
examples.zh: 罷工讓工作中止。

examples.zh: 橋上的車流完全停住了。

examples.zh: 她的字跡工整，很容易閱讀。

examples.zh: 我看不懂醫師的筆跡。

examples.en: Good handwriting can make a better first impression.
examples.zh: 一手好字能給人更好的第一印象。

examples.zh: 水災過後，這家人面臨極大的困境。

examples.zh: 她克服了許多困難才完成學業。

examples.zh: 許多人去年遭遇經濟上的困難。

examples.zh: 這台電腦需要更新硬體才能跑得更快。

examples.zh: 我父親在五金行買了一些工具。

examples.en: The school spent money on classroom hardware.
examples.zh: 學校花錢購買教室的硬體設備。

examples.en: The neighbors live together in harmony and help one another.
examples.zh: 鄰居們和睦相處，並互相幫助。

examples.en: The choir sang in perfect harmony during the school concert.
examples.zh: 合唱團在學校音樂會上唱出完美的和聲。

examples.zh: 這個房間的色彩彼此協調。

examples.zh: 老師的話對那個小男孩來說太嚴厲了。

examples.zh: 嚴酷的冬天持續了四個月。

examples.zh: 我走進房間時，刺眼的光線弄痛了我的眼睛。

examples.zh: 這個故事說明仇恨如何傷害一個家庭。

examples.zh: 他非常痛恨謊言。

examples.zh: 善良是對付仇恨的最好方式。
